            di = MM[o[0].reg]; src = mm_src(1, False)
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _a=c->mm[{di}], _b=({src}), _r=0;"
                    f" for(int _k=0;_k<2;_k++){{ int32_t _s=0;"
                    f" for(int _j=0;_j<2;_j++){{ int _i=_k*2+_j;"
                    f" _s += (int32_t)(int16_t)(_a>>(_i*16)) * (int32_t)(int16_t)(_b>>(_i*16)); }}"
                    f" _r |= (uint64_t)(uint32_t)_s << (_k*32); }} c->mm[{di}]=_r; }}"]

        # ---------------- SSE packed single precision ----------------
        # ---------------- SSE2 packed/scalar double ----------------
        PD = {'addpd':'+','subpd':'-','mulpd':'*','divpd':'/'}
        if m in PD and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]; op_c = PD[m]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF64({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=8*k)})")
            return [f"{{ double _a=c->xmm[{di}].d[{k}], _b={src(k)};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].d[{k}]=sse_r2d(_a,_b,_a {op_c} _b); }}" for k in (0,1)]
        if m in ('minpd','maxpd','sqrtpd') and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF64({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=8*k)})")
            if m == 'sqrtpd':
                return [f"{{ double _a={src(k)}; c->xmm[{di}].d[{k}]=sse_r1d(_a,sqrt(_a)); }}"
                        for k in (0,1)]
            cop = '>' if m=='maxpd' else '<'
            return [f"{{ double _a=c->xmm[{di}].d[{k}], _b={src(k)};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].d[{k}] = (_a {cop} _b) ? _a : _b; }}" for k in (0,1)]

        # ---------------- SSE scalar min/max/sqrt ----------------
        if m in ('minss','maxss','sqrtss','rcpss','rsqrtss') and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            if m == 'sqrtss':
                return [f"{{ float _a={src}; c->xmm[{di}].f[0]=sse_r1f(_a,sqrtf(_a)); }}"]
            if m == 'rcpss':   return [f"c->xmm[{di}].f[0] = 1.0f/({src});"]
            if m == 'rsqrtss': return [f"c->xmm[{di}].f[0] = 1.0f/sqrtf({src});"]
            cop = '>' if m=='maxss' else '<'
            return [f"{{ float _a=c->xmm[{di}].f[0], _b={src};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].f[0] = (_a {cop} _b) ? _a : _b; }}"]
        if m in ('minsd','maxsd','sqrtsd') and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF64{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            if m == 'sqrtsd':
                return [f"{{ double _a={src}; c->xmm[{di}].d[0]=sse_r1d(_a,sqrt(_a)); }}"]
            cop = '>' if m=='maxsd' else '<'
            return [f"{{ double _a=c->xmm[{di}].d[0], _b={src};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].d[0] = (_a {cop} _b) ? _a : _b; }}"]

        # ---------------- SSE compares (cmpps/cmpss/cmppd/cmpsd) -------------
        # capstone folds the predicate into the mnemonic: cmpeqps, cmpnltss, ...
        CMPPRED = {'eq':'(_a==_b)', 'lt':'(_a<_b)', 'le':'(_a<=_b)',
                   'unord':'(_a!=_a||_b!=_b)', 'neq':'!(_a==_b)',
                   'nlt':'!(_a<_b)', 'nle':'!(_a<=_b)',
                   'ord':'(_a==_a&&_b==_b)'}
        for _pred, _ex in CMPPRED.items():
            for _sfx, _lanes, _cty, _fld, _msk in (('ps',4,'float','f','0xFFFFFFFFu'),
                                                   ('ss',1,'float','f','0xFFFFFFFFu'),
                                                   ('pd',2,'double','d','0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull'),
                                                   ('sd',1,'double','d','0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull')):
                if m != 'cmp' + _pred + _sfx or not is_xm(0): continue
                di = XM[o[0].reg]
                esz = 4 if _cty == 'float' else 8
                uf  = 'u32' if _cty == 'float' else 'u64'
                if is_xm(1):
                    srcf = lambda k, si=XM[o[1].reg]: f"c->xmm[{si}].{_fld}[{k}]"
                else:
                    rdm = 'MRF32' if _cty == 'float' else 'MRF64'
                    srcf = lambda k: f"{rdm}({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=esz*k)})"
                return [f"{{ {_cty} _a=c->xmm[{di}].{_fld}[{k}], _b={srcf(k)};"
                        f" c->xmm[{di}].{uf}[{k}] = {_ex} ? {_msk} : 0; }}"
                        for k in range(_lanes)]

        # ---------------- SSE conversions ----------------
        # MMX <-> SSE (v12na port): 0x73392f 'cvtpi2ps xmm6,[0x8191c0]' runs in
        # the race with performance level 4 and used to trap (no-op).
        if m == 'cvtpi2ps' and is_xm(0):          # 2 x int32 -> low 2 floats, high kept
            di = XM[o[0].reg]; q = mm_src(1, False)
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _q=({q}); c->xmm[{di}].f[0]=(float)(int32_t)(uint32_t)_q;"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].f[1]=(float)(int32_t)(uint32_t)(_q>>32); }}"]
        if m == 'cvtpi2pd' and is_xm(0):          # 2 x int32 -> 2 doubles
            di = XM[o[0].reg]; q = mm_src(1, False)
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _q=({q}); c->xmm[{di}].d[0]=(double)(int32_t)(uint32_t)_q;"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].d[1]=(double)(int32_t)(uint32_t)(_q>>32); }}"]
        if m in ('cvtps2pi','cvttps2pi') and is_mm(0):
            dm = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF32({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=4*k)})")
            rnd = 'trunc' if m == 'cvttps2pi' else 'nearbyint'
            return [f"{{ double _a=(double)({src(0)}), _b=(double)({src(1)});"
                    f" c->mm[{dm}] = (uint64_t)x86_cvt_i32({rnd}(_a))"
                    f" | ((uint64_t)x86_cvt_i32({rnd}(_b)) << 32); }}"]
        if m in ('cvtpd2pi','cvttpd2pi') and is_mm(0):
            dm = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF64({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=8*k)})")
            rnd = 'trunc' if m == 'cvttpd2pi' else 'nearbyint'
            return [f"{{ double _a=({src(0)}), _b=({src(1)});"
                    f" c->mm[{dm}] = (uint64_t)x86_cvt_i32({rnd}(_a))"
                    f" | ((uint64_t)x86_cvt_i32({rnd}(_b)) << 32); }}"]
        if m in ('cvtps2dq','cvttps2dq') and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF32({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=4*k)})")
            rnd = 'trunc' if m == 'cvttps2dq' else 'nearbyint'
            return [f"{{ double _t[4]; " +
                    " ".join(f"_t[{k}]=(double)({src(k)});" for k in range(4)) +
                    " " + " ".join(f"c->xmm[{di}].u32[{k}]=x86_cvt_i32({rnd}(_t[{k}]));"
                                   for k in range(4)) + " }"]
        if m == 'cvtdq2ps' and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"(int32_t)c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].u32[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"(int32_t)MR32({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=4*k)})")
            return [f"{{ int32_t _t[4]; " +
                    " ".join(f"_t[{k}]={src(k)};" for k in range(4)) +
                    " " + " ".join(f"c->xmm[{di}].f[{k}]=(float)_t[{k}];" for k in range(4)) + " }"]
        if m == 'cvtdq2pd' and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"(int32_t)c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].u32[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"(int32_t)MR32({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=4*k)})")
            return [f"{{ int32_t _a={src(0)}, _b={src(1)};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].d[0]=(double)_a; c->xmm[{di}].d[1]=(double)_b; }}"]
        if m == 'cvtps2pd' and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF32({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=4*k)})")
            return [f"{{ float _a={src(0)}, _b={src(1)};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].d[0]=(double)_a; c->xmm[{di}].d[1]=(double)_b; }}"]
        if m == 'cvtpd2ps' and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF64({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=8*k)})")
            return [f"{{ double _a={src(0)}, _b={src(1)};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].f[0]=(float)_a; c->xmm[{di}].f[1]=(float)_b;"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].u64[1]=0; }}"]
        if m in ('cvtpd2dq','cvttpd2dq') and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]
            src = (lambda k: f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[{k}]") if is_xm(1) else \
                  (lambda k: f"MRF64({self.ea(o[1].mem, extra=8*k)})")
            rnd = 'trunc' if m == 'cvttpd2dq' else 'nearbyint'
            return [f"{{ double _a={src(0)}, _b={src(1)};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].u32[0]=x86_cvt_i32({rnd}(_a));"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].u32[1]=x86_cvt_i32({rnd}(_b));"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].u64[1]=0; }}"]

        PS = {'addps':'+','subps':'-','mulps':'*','divps':'/'}
        SS = {'addss':'+','subss':'-','mulss':'*','divss':'/'}
        if m in PS and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]; op_c = PS[m]
            src = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[_k]" if is_xm(1)
                   else f"MRF32(({self.ea(o[1].mem)})+4u*(uint32_t)_k)")
            return [f"for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++){{ float _a=c->xmm[{di}].f[_k], _b={src};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].f[_k]=sse_r2f(_a,_b,_a {op_c} _b); }}"]
        if m in SS and is_xm(0):
            di = XM[o[0].reg]; op_c = SS[m]
            src = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"{{ float _a=c->xmm[{di}].f[0], _b={src};"
                    f" c->xmm[{di}].f[0]=sse_r2f(_a,_b,_a {op_c} _b); }}"]
        if m=='shufps' and is_xm(0) and o[2].type==X86_OP_IMM:
            di=XM[o[0].reg]; imm=o[2].imm & 0xff
            sel=[(imm>>0)&3,(imm>>2)&3,(imm>>4)&3,(imm>>6)&3]
            if is_xm(1):
                src = f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f"
                pre = ""
            else:                       # v12na: shufps xmm, m128, imm (0x68998d)
                src = "_m"; pre = f" float _m[4]; memcpy(_m, g_mem + (uint32_t){self.ea(o[1].mem)}, 16);"
            return [f"{{{pre} float _t[4]; _t[0]=c->xmm[{di}].f[{sel[0]}]; _t[1]=c->xmm[{di}].f[{sel[1]}];"
                    f" _t[2]={src}[{sel[2]}]; _t[3]={src}[{sel[3]}];"
                    f" for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++) c->xmm[{di}].f[_k]=_t[_k]; }}"]
        if m in ('sqrtps','rcpps','rsqrtps','maxps','minps') and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            if m in ('sqrtps','rcpps','rsqrtps'):
                fn={'sqrtps':'sqrtf(_x)','rcpps':'(1.0f/_x)','rsqrtps':'(1.0f/sqrtf(_x))'}[m]
                src = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[_k]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32({self.ea(o[1].mem)}+4u*(uint32_t)_k)")
                return [f"for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++){{ float _x={src}; c->xmm[{di}].f[_k]={fn}; }}"]
            cmpf = 'a>b?a:b' if m=='maxps' else 'a<b?a:b'
            src = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[_k]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32({self.ea(o[1].mem)}+4u*(uint32_t)_k)")
            return [f"for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++){{ float a=c->xmm[{di}].f[_k], b={src}; c->xmm[{di}].f[_k]=({cmpf}); }}"]
        if m in ('movlps','movhps') and is_xm(0) and is_mem(1):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]; ea2=self.ea(o[1].mem); off2 = 0 if m=='movlps' else 2
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].u32[{off2}]=MR32({ea2}); c->xmm[{di}].u32[{off2+1}]=MR32(({ea2})+4u);"]
        if m in ('movlps','movhps') and is_mem(0) and is_xm(1):
            si=XM[o[1].reg]; ea2=self.ea(o[0].mem); off2 = 0 if m=='movlps' else 2
            return [f"MR32({ea2})=c->xmm[{si}].u32[{off2}]; MR32(({ea2})+4u)=c->xmm[{si}].u32[{off2+1}];"]
        if m in ('cvtsi2ss',) and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].f[0] = (float)(int32_t)({E(1)});"]
        if m in ('cvttss2si','cvtss2si'):
            src = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            # without 't' MXCSR rounding (default: nearest); with it, truncation
            expr = f"trunc((double)({src}))" if m=='cvttss2si' else f"nearbyint((double)({src}))"
            return [W(0, f"x86_cvt_i32({expr})")]
        if m in ('ucomiss','comiss'):
            a = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[0].reg]}].f[0]" if is_xm(0) else f"MRF32{self.ea(o[0].mem)}")
            b = (f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"{{ float _x={a}, _y={b};"
                    f" if(_x!=_x||_y!=_y){{ c->zf=1;c->pf=1;c->cf=1; }}"
                    f" else {{ c->pf=0; c->zf=(_x==_y); c->cf=(_x<_y); }} c->of=c->sf=c->af=0; }}"]
        # 3DNow! (AMD) - rarely real code, mostly misdecoded data

        # ---------------- 3DNow! (AMD) : 2x float in MMX registers ----------------
        PF = {'pfadd':'+','pfsub':'-','pfmul':'*','pfsubr':'r-','pfmax':'max','pfmin':'min',
              'pfacc':'acc','pfcmpeq':'==','pfcmpge':'>=','pfcmpgt':'>'}
        if m in PF and is_mm(0):
            di = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->mm[{MM[o[1].reg]}]" if is_mm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
            op_c = PF[m]
            pre = (f"{{ uint64_t _av=c->mm[{di}], _bv=({src}); float _a0,_a1,_b0,_b1,_r0,_r1;"
                   f" memcpy(&_a0,(char*)&_av,4); memcpy(&_a1,(char*)&_av+4,4);"
                   f" memcpy(&_b0,(char*)&_bv,4); memcpy(&_b1,(char*)&_bv+4,4);")
            if op_c in ('+','-','*'):
                body = f" _r0=_a0{op_c}_b0; _r1=_a1{op_c}_b1;"
            elif op_c=='r-':
                body = " _r0=_b0-_a0; _r1=_b1-_a1;"
            elif op_c=='max':
                body = " _r0=_a0>_b0?_a0:_b0; _r1=_a1>_b1?_a1:_b1;"
            elif op_c=='min':
                body = " _r0=_a0<_b0?_a0:_b0; _r1=_a1<_b1?_a1:_b1;"
            elif op_c=='acc':
                body = " _r0=_a0+_a1; _r1=_b0+_b1;"
            else:
                cmp2 = {'==':'==','>=':'>=','>':'>'}[op_c]
                return [pre + f" uint32_t _c0=(_a0{cmp2}_b0)?0xFFFFFFFFu:0u, _c1=(_a1{cmp2}_b1)?0xFFFFFFFFu:0u;"
                        f" uint64_t _rv=((uint64_t)_c1<<32)|_c0; c->mm[{di}]=_rv; }}"]
            return [pre + body + f" uint64_t _rv=0; memcpy((char*)&_rv,&_r0,4); memcpy((char*)&_rv+4,&_r1,4);"
                    f" c->mm[{di}]=_rv; }}"]
        if m in ('pfrcp','pfrsqrt') and is_mm(0):
            di = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->mm[{MM[o[1].reg]}]" if is_mm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
            fn = "(1.0f/_b0)" if m=='pfrcp' else "(1.0f/sqrtf(_b0))"
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _bv=({src}); float _b0; memcpy(&_b0,(char*)&_bv,4);"
                    f" float _r={fn}; uint64_t _rv=0; memcpy((char*)&_rv,&_r,4); memcpy((char*)&_rv+4,&_r,4);"
                    f" c->mm[{di}]=_rv; }}"]
        if m=='pi2fd' and is_mm(0):
            di = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->mm[{MM[o[1].reg]}]" if is_mm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _bv=({src}); float _r0=(float)(int32_t)(uint32_t)_bv,"
                    f" _r1=(float)(int32_t)(uint32_t)(_bv>>32); uint64_t _rv=0;"
                    f" memcpy((char*)&_rv,&_r0,4); memcpy((char*)&_rv+4,&_r1,4); c->mm[{di}]=_rv; }}"]
        if m=='pf2id' and is_mm(0):
            di = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->mm[{MM[o[1].reg]}]" if is_mm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _bv=({src}); float _b0,_b1; memcpy(&_b0,(char*)&_bv,4);"
                    f" memcpy(&_b1,(char*)&_bv+4,4);"
                    f" uint64_t _rv=((uint64_t)(uint32_t)(int32_t)_b1<<32)|(uint32_t)(int32_t)_b0;"
                    f" c->mm[{di}]=_rv; }}"]
        if m=='femms': return ["/* femms */"]
        if m in ('pmulhw','pmulhuw') and is_mm(0):
            di = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->mm[{MM[o[1].reg]}]" if is_mm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
            sgn = 'int16_t' if m=='pmulhw' else 'uint16_t'
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _a=c->mm[{di}], _b=({src}), _r=0;"
                    f" for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++){{ int32_t _p=(int32_t)({sgn})(_a>>(_k*16))"
                    f" * (int32_t)({sgn})(_b>>(_k*16));"
                    f" _r |= ((uint64_t)(uint16_t)(_p>>16)) << (_k*16); }} c->mm[{di}]=_r; }}"]
        if m in ('pcmpeqb','pcmpeqw','pcmpeqd','pcmpgtb','pcmpgtw','pcmpgtd') and is_mm(0):
            esz = {'b':1,'w':2,'d':4}[m[-1]]
            gt  = 'gt' in m
            di = MM[o[0].reg]
            src = (f"c->mm[{MM[o[1].reg]}]" if is_mm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
            n = 8//esz; bits2 = esz*8
            st = {1:'int8_t',2:'int16_t',4:'int32_t'}[esz]
            cmp2 = '>' if gt else '=='
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _a=c->mm[{di}], _b=({src}), _r=0;"
                    f" for(int _k=0;_k<{n};_k++){{"
                    f" {st} _x=({st})(_a>>(_k*{bits2})), _y=({st})(_b>>(_k*{bits2}));"
                    f" uint64_t _m2 = (_x {cmp2} _y) ? ((1ull<<{bits2})-1) : 0ull;"
                    f" _r |= _m2 << (_k*{bits2}); }} c->mm[{di}]=_r; }}"]

        # ---------------- last missing ones ----------------
        if m in ('in','out','insb','insw','insd','outsb','outsw','outsd',
                 'cli','sti','hlt','clts','invd','wbinvd','lgdt','lidt','lldt','ltr',
                 'arpl','bound','into','sysenter','sysexit','rdmsr','wrmsr','rdpmc'):
            # These never run in user mode; they are misdecoded data.
            return [f"/* {m}: privileged/data - no effect */"]
        SD = {'addsd':'+','subsd':'-','mulsd':'*','divsd':'/'}
        if m in SD and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]; op_c=SD[m]
            src=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF64{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].d[0] {op_c}= {src};"]
        if m in ('sqrtsd',) and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            src=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF64{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].d[0] = sqrt({src});"]
        if m in ('sqrtss',) and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            src=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].f[0] = sqrtf({src});"]
        if m in ('movhlps','movlhps') and is_xm(0) and is_xm(1):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]; si=XM[o[1].reg]
            if m=='movhlps':
                return [f"c->xmm[{di}].u32[0]=c->xmm[{si}].u32[2]; c->xmm[{di}].u32[1]=c->xmm[{si}].u32[3];"]
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].u32[2]=c->xmm[{si}].u32[0]; c->xmm[{di}].u32[3]=c->xmm[{si}].u32[1];"]
        if m in ('cvtsi2sd',) and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].d[0] = (double)(int32_t)({E(1)});"]
        if m in ('cvttsd2si','cvtsd2si'):
            src=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF64{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            expr = f"trunc({src})" if m=='cvttsd2si' else f"nearbyint({src})"
            return [W(0, f"x86_cvt_i32({expr})")]
        if m in ('cvtss2sd',) and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            src=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].f[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF32{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].d[0] = (double)({src});"]
        if m in ('cvtsd2ss',) and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            src=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF64{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"c->xmm[{di}].f[0] = (float)({src});"]
        if m in ('ucomisd','comisd'):
            a=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[0].reg]}].d[0]" if is_xm(0) else f"MRF64{self.ea(o[0].mem)}")
            b=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].d[0]" if is_xm(1) else f"MRF64{self.ea(o[1].mem)}")
            return [f"{{ double _x={a}, _y={b};"
                    f" if(_x!=_x||_y!=_y){{ c->zf=1;c->pf=1;c->cf=1; }}"
                    f" else {{ c->pf=0; c->zf=(_x==_y); c->cf=(_x<_y); }} c->of=c->sf=c->af=0; }}"]
        if m == 'int3':
            return ["/* int3: padding in release code - no effect */"]
        if m in ('pandn','andnps','andnpd'):
            if is_mm(0):
                di=MM[o[0].reg]
                src=(f"c->mm[{MM[o[1].reg]}]" if is_mm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
                return [f"c->mm[{di}] = (~c->mm[{di}]) & ({src});"]
            if is_xm(0):
                di=XM[o[0].reg]
                if is_xm(1):
                    si=XM[o[1].reg]
                    return [f"c->xmm[{di}].u64[0] = (~c->xmm[{di}].u64[0]) & c->xmm[{si}].u64[0];"
                            f" c->xmm[{di}].u64[1] = (~c->xmm[{di}].u64[1]) & c->xmm[{si}].u64[1];"]
                ea2=self.ea(o[1].mem)
                return [f"{{ uint64_t _a=MR64({ea2}), _b=MR64(({ea2})+8u);"
                        f" c->xmm[{di}].u64[0] = (~c->xmm[{di}].u64[0]) & _a;"
                        f" c->xmm[{di}].u64[1] = (~c->xmm[{di}].u64[1]) & _b; }}"]
            raise Unsupported(m)
        if m in ('unpcklps','unpckhps') and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]; hi = (m=='unpckhps')
            if is_xm(1):
                sv=f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].u32"
            else:
                ea2=self.ea(o[1].mem); sv=None
            o0 = 2 if hi else 0
            if sv:
                return [f"{{ uint32_t _t[4]; _t[0]=c->xmm[{di}].u32[{o0}]; _t[1]={sv}[{o0}];"
                        f" _t[2]=c->xmm[{di}].u32[{o0+1}]; _t[3]={sv}[{o0+1}];"
                        f" for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++) c->xmm[{di}].u32[_k]=_t[_k]; }}"]
            return [f"{{ uint32_t _t[4]; _t[0]=c->xmm[{di}].u32[{o0}]; _t[1]=MR32(({ea2})+{4*o0}u);"
                    f" _t[2]=c->xmm[{di}].u32[{o0+1}]; _t[3]=MR32(({ea2})+{4*(o0+1)}u);"
                    f" for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++) c->xmm[{di}].u32[_k]=_t[_k]; }}"]
        if m=='packuswb' and is_xm(0):
            di=XM[o[0].reg]
            src=(f"c->xmm[{XM[o[1].reg]}].u64[0]" if is_xm(1) else "MR64"+self.ea(o[1].mem))
            return [f"{{ uint64_t _a=c->xmm[{di}].u64[0], _b=({src}), _r=0;"
                    f" for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++){{ int32_t _x=(int16_t)(_a>>(_k*16)); if(_x<0)_x=0; if(_x>255)_x=255;"
                    f" _r |= (uint64_t)(uint8_t)_x << (_k*8); }}"
                    f" for(int _k=0;_k<4;_k++){{ int32_t _y=(int16_t)(_b>>(_k*16)); if(_y<0)_y=0; if(_y>255)_y=255;"
                    f" _r |= (uint64_t)(uint8_t)_y << ((4+_k)*8); }} c->xmm[{di}].u64[0]=_r; }}"]
        if m in ('movlpd','movhpd'):
            base_m = 'movlps' if m=='movlpd' else 'movhps'
            off2 = 0 if m=='movlpd' else 2
            if is_xm(0) and is_mem(1):
                di=XM[o[0].reg]; ea2=self.ea(o[1].mem)
                return [f"c->xmm[{di}].u32[{off2}]=MR32({ea2}); c->xmm[{di}].u32[{off2+1}]=MR32(({ea2})+4u);"]
            if is_mem(0) and is_xm(1):
                si=XM[o[1].reg]; ea2=self.ea(o[0].mem)
                return [f"MR32({ea2})=c->xmm[{si}].u32[{off2}]; MR32(({ea2})+4u)=c->xmm[{si}].u32[{off2+1}];"]
            raise Unsupported(m)
        if m in ('pfrcpit1','pfrcpit2','pfrsqit1'):
            # 3DNow Newton-Raphson refinement steps: dst is accurate enough already
            return [f"/* {m}: refinement step skipped */"]
        if m in ('pfnacc','pfpnacc') and is_mm(0):
            return [f"/* {m} */"]
        if m in ('prefetch','prefetchw','prefetchnta','prefetcht0','prefetcht1','prefetcht2',
                 'sfence','lfence','mfence','pause','nop2'):
            return [f"/* {m}: no effect */"]

        raise Unsupported(m)

    # ---------- function -> C ----------
    def lift(self, entry):
        blocks, calls = self.discover(entry)
        self.last_blocks = blocks; self.entry = entry
        addrs = sorted(blocks)
        # Flag liveness: for every instruction the mask "which flags are read
        # after this one".  FLAGOPT=0 turns it off (for A/B comparisons).
        # A callee of tools/retpast.txt counts as returning flags: when it
        # returns past its caller, the caller's early return hands them on.
        import os as _os
        if _os.environ.get('FLAGOPT','1') == '0':
            self.fafter = {}
        else:
            abi = abi_table()
            try:
                if abi:
                    _, self.fafter, _ = abi_liveness(abi_cfg(blocks, self.in_text, self.jtab), entry, abi[0],
                                                     entry in abi[1] or entry in self.retpast)
                else:
                    self.fafter = flag_liveness(blocks, addrs, self.in_text)
            except Exception: self.fafter = {}
        # collect the branch targets
        lbl=set(addrs)
        out=[]; targets=set()
        body=[]
        x87opt = _os.environ.get('X87OPT','') == '1'
        xb = X87Region()
        for ba in addrs:
            body.append(f"L_{ba:08x}:; /* --- block --- */")
            ins=blocks[ba]
            xb.reset()
            for k,i in enumerate(ins):
                m=i.mnemonic
                if x87opt and xb.active and (m=='jmp' or (m.startswith('j') and m[1:] in CC)
                        or m in ('jecxz','jcxz','loop','loope','loopz','loopne','loopnz')):
                    body += ["    "+l for l in xb.close()]
                if self.watch:
                    body.append(f"    WCHK(0x{i.address:x}u);")
                if self.comments:
                    body.append(f"    /* {i.address:08x}  {i.mnemonic} {i.op_str} */")
                if i.address in self.hooks:
                    # a hook reads and may change ST(0) (widescreen FOV) or
                    # other x87 state: the open X87OPT region is written back
                    # first, and the next x87 instruction reloads from c->st
                    if x87opt and xb.active:
                        body += ["    "+l for l in xb.close()]
                    body.append(f"    guest_hook(c, 0x{i.address:x}u);")
                if m=='jmp':
                    o0=i.operands[0]
                    if o0.type==X86_OP_IMM and self.in_text(o0.imm):
                        body.append(f"    goto L_{o0.imm:08x};"); continue
                    if o0.type==X86_OP_IMM:
                        self.oob_branch = getattr(self,'oob_branch',0)+1
                        body.append(f"    DISPATCH_TAIL(c, 0x{o0.imm & 0xffffffff:x}u);")
                        continue
                    if o0.type!=X86_OP_IMM:
                        tab = self.jtab.get(i.address)
                        if tab:
                            reg, d, ents = tab
                            body.append(f"    switch (c->{R32[reg]}) {{   /* jump table 0x{d:x} */")
                            for k, t in enumerate(ents):
                                body.append(f"    case {k}u: if (MR32(0x{d + 4 * k:x}u) == 0x{t:x}u) goto L_{t:08x}; break;")
                            body.append("    }")
                        body.append(f"    DISPATCH_TAIL(c, {self.rd(o0)});   /* indirect tail call */")
                        continue
                # jecxz/jcxz and the loop family: the condition is not in the CC table.
                # CRITICAL: if these are not lifted, the early-exit branches of CRT
                # routines such as strncmp/strlen are lost.
                LOOPC = {'jecxz':'(c->ecx == 0u)', 'jcxz':'((c->ecx & 0xffffu) == 0u)'}
                if m in LOOPC and i.operands[0].type==X86_OP_IMM:
                    _t=i.operands[0].imm
                    if self.in_text(_t):
                        body.append(f"    if({LOOPC[m]}) goto L_{_t:08x};")
                    else:
                        body.append(f"    if({LOOPC[m]}) DISPATCH_TAIL(c, 0x{_t & 0xffffffff:x}u)")
                    nxt=i.address+i.size
                    if k==len(ins)-1 and nxt in lbl: body.append(f"    goto L_{nxt:08x};")
                    continue
                if m in ('loop','loope','loopz','loopne','loopnz') and i.operands[0].type==X86_OP_IMM:
                    extra = {'loop':'', 'loope':' && c->zf', 'loopz':' && c->zf',
                             'loopne':' && !c->zf', 'loopnz':' && !c->zf'}[m]
                    _t=i.operands[0].imm
                    body.append(f"    c->ecx--;")
                    if self.in_text(_t):
                        body.append(f"    if(c->ecx != 0u{extra}) goto L_{_t:08x};")
                    else:
                        body.append(f"    if(c->ecx != 0u{extra}) DISPATCH_TAIL(c, 0x{_t & 0xffffffff:x}u)")
                    nxt=i.address+i.size
                    if k==len(ins)-1 and nxt in lbl: body.append(f"    goto L_{nxt:08x};")
                    continue
                if m.startswith('j') and m[1:] in CC and i.operands[0].type==X86_OP_IMM:
                    _t=i.operands[0].imm
                    if self.in_text(_t):
                        body.append(f"    if({CC[m[1:]]}) goto L_{_t:08x};")
                    else:
                        self.oob_branch = getattr(self,'oob_branch',0)+1
                        body.append(f"    if({CC[m[1:]]}) {{ unsupported_insn(c, 0x{i.address:x}u, \"branch-out\"); POP32(c->eip); return; }}")
                    nxt=i.address+i.size
                    if k==len(ins)-1 and nxt in lbl: body.append(f"    goto L_{nxt:08x};")
                    continue
                self.cur_fmask = self.fafter.get(i.address, F_ALL)
                try:
                    lines = self.insn(i, targets)
                    if x87opt:
                        if m[:1]=='f' or X86_GRP_FPU in i.groups:
                            new_lines = xb.translate(lines)
                            if new_lines is None:
                                body += ["    "+l for l in xb.close()]
                            else:
                                lines = new_lines
                        elif xb.active and any(_BOUNDARY_RE.search(l) for l in lines):
                            body += ["    "+l for l in xb.close()]
                    for line in lines:
                        body.append("    "+line)
                except Unsupported as e:
                    if not self.trap: raise
                    self.traps+=1; self.trap_kinds[str(e)]+=1
                    esc=str(e).replace('"','')
                    body.append(f'    unsupported_insn(c, 0x{i.address:x}u, "{esc}");')
                except Exception as e:
                    if not self.trap: raise
                    self.traps+=1; self.trap_kinds[f"<{type(e).__name__}>"]+=1
                    body.append(f'    unsupported_insn(c, 0x{i.address:x}u, "internal");')
            if x87opt: body += ["    "+l for l in xb.close()]
            # if the block falls through, jump to the next block
            last=ins[-1] if ins else None
            if last is not None and last.mnemonic not in ('ret','retf','jmp') and not (last.mnemonic.startswith('j') and last.mnemonic[1:] in CC):
                nxt=last.address+last.size
                if nxt in lbl: body.append(f"    goto L_{nxt:08x};")
        # stub labels for the branch targets not generated because of truncation
        refs=set()
        for ba in addrs:
            for i in blocks[ba]:
                m=i.mnemonic
                if (m=='jmp' or (m.startswith('j') and m[1:] in CC)
                    or m in ('jecxz','jcxz','loop','loope','loopz','loopne','loopnz')) \
                   and i.operands and i.operands[0].type==X86_OP_IMM:
                    if self.in_text(i.operands[0].imm): refs.add(i.operands[0].imm)
        missing = sorted(refs - set(addrs))
        for t in missing:
            body.append(f"L_{t:08x}: unsupported_insn(c, 0x{t:x}u, \"truncated\"); POP32(c->eip); return;")
        self.truncated = len(missing)
        out.append(f"/* ===== sub_{entry:08x}  ({sum(len(b) for b in blocks.values())} insns, {len(blocks)} blocks) ===== */")
        # restrict: the guest registers live in the CPU struct, and MR32() writes
        # the SAME type (uint32_t) into g_mem -- so the compiler had to reload
        # fields such as c->eax after every guest memory write.  The CPU
        # struct is not INSIDE g_mem, so restrict is correct and safe
        # (measured: race frame -1.7%).
        out.append(f"void sub_{entry:08x}(CPU *restrict c) {{")
        if self.cov:
            # COVERAGE: to see which functions NEVER run.
            # A single increment; the run-time cost is negligible.
            out.append(f"    cov_hit(0x{entry:08x}u);")
        # CRITICAL: the blocks are printed in address order; the entry block need
        # not have the lowest address.  C execution starts at the top of the body,
        # so the entry block must be jumped to explicitly.
        if xb.used:
            out.append("    uint32_t _T = 0; double _x[16];")
        out.append(f"    goto L_{entry:08x};")
        out += body
        out.append("}")
        code = "\n".join(out)
        if _os.environ.get('LREGS', '') == '1':
            # registers and flags as locals, stored only where others look (tools/lregs.py)
            # (the early 'if (c->eip != ...) return;' after a call to a callee of
            # tools/retpast.txt is a return site like any other: the call has just
            # brought the locals in step, so it stores nothing)
            abi = abi_table()
            code = _lregs().transform(code, abi[0] if abi else None, (abi[1] | self.retpast) if abi else None)
        return code, targets|calls

if __name__=='__main__':
    exe=sys.argv[1]; L=Lifter(exe)
    hdr=['#include "cpu.h"','#include <math.h>','void dispatch_indirect(CPU*,uint32_t);','void dispatch_tail(CPU*);','void cpuid_shim(CPU*);','uint64_t rdtsc_shim(void);','']
    decls=[]; bodies=[]
    for a in sys.argv[2:]:
        ea=int(a,16)
        try:
            code,tg = L.lift(ea)
            decls.append(f"void sub_{ea:08x}(CPU *c);")
            for t in sorted(tg):
                if L.in_text(t): decls.append(f"void sub_{t:08x}(CPU *c);")
            bodies.append(code)
        except Unsupported as e:
            print(f"// 0x{ea:08x} COULD NOT BE LIFTED: unsupported '{e}'", file=sys.stderr)
    print("\n".join(hdr + sorted(set(decls)) + [''] + bodies))

    setattr(RawLifter, _m, getattr(Lifter, _m))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Instruction-level profile of the lifted code: which x86 instruction kinds
does the game thread's time go to?

    python3 tools/lift_profile.py <PERFLOG dir> [--src gen/prof] [--from 6400 --to 9400]

Requirements: the recording must come from a binary built from annotated shards
(COMMENTS=1) and with -gline-tables-only.  --from/--to bound the window by guest
frame.  Each sample's leaf PC is mapped with atos -i to a shard line, and the line
to the preceding "/* address  instruction operands */" comment, i.e. to the x86
instruction.  Standard library + atos only.
"""
import bisect, collections, os, re, struct, subprocess, sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import session_report as sr

INSN_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*/\* ([0-9a-f]{8})  (\S+)(?: (.*?))? \*/\s*$')


def category(mn, ops):
    ops = ops or ''
    if mn.startswith('f') and mn not in ('femms',):
        if mn in ('fld', 'fild', 'fstp', 'fst', 'fistp', 'fist', 'fisttp', 'fldz', 'fld1', 'fxch', 'fnstsw', 'fstsw',
                  'fnstcw', 'fldcw', 'ffree', 'fdecstp', 'fincstp'):
            return 'x87 load/store/stack'
        if mn.startswith(('fcom', 'fucom', 'ftst')):
            return 'x87 compare'
        return 'x87 arithmetic'
    if re.match(r'(mov|add|sub|mul|div|min|max|sqrt|rsqrt|rcp|cvt|ucomi|comi|and|andn|or|xor|shuf|unpck)(ss|sd|ps|pd)$', mn) \
            or mn.startswith(('cvt', 'movaps', 'movups', 'movss', 'movsd', 'movhps', 'movlps')) or mn in ('pxor',):
        return 'SSE'
    if mn.startswith('p') and mn not in ('push', 'pushal', 'pushfd', 'pop', 'popal', 'popfd'):
        return 'MMX/SSE integer'
    if mn in ('call',):
        return 'call'
    if mn in ('ret', 'retn'):
        return 'return'
    if mn in ('push', 'pop', 'pushal', 'popal', 'pushfd', 'popfd'):
        return 'push/pop'
    if mn in ('jmp',) or (mn.startswith('j')):
        return 'branch'
    if mn in ('cmp', 'test'):
        return 'cmp/test (flags)'
    if mn.startswith(('rep', 'movs', 'stos', 'lods', 'scas', 'cmps')):
        return 'string (rep)'
    if mn in ('mov', 'movzx', 'movsx', 'lea', 'xchg', 'cdq', 'cwde', 'cbw') or mn.startswith('cmov') or mn.startswith('set'):
        mem = '[' in ops
        if mn == 'lea':
            return 'lea'
        return 'mov memory' if mem else 'mov register'
    if mn in ('add', 'sub', 'and', 'or', 'xor', 'inc', 'dec', 'neg', 'not', 'adc', 'sbb', 'shl', 'shr', 'sar', 'rol',
              'ror', 'sal', 'shld', 'shrd', 'imul', 'mul', 'idiv', 'div', 'bt', 'bts', 'btr', 'bsf', 'bsr', 'bswap'):
        return 'integer ALU' + (' (memory)' if '[' in ops else '')
    return 'other: ' + mn


def main():
    d = sys.argv[1]
    src = 'gen/prof'
    if '--src' in sys.argv:
        src = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--src') + 1]
    m = sr.read_meta(d)
    binary = m['binary']
    lo, hi = (int(x, 16) for x in m['text'].split())
    samp = [o for o in sr.read_samples(d) if o[2] == 0]
    # race window: by guest frame (gframe)
    frame_from = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--from') + 1]) if '--from' in sys.argv else 0
    frame_to = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--to') + 1]) if '--to' in sys.argv else 1 << 31
    samp = [o for o in samp if frame_from <= o[1] < frame_to]
    sb = sr.Symbols(d, m)

    # waiting samples (frame limiter sleep etc.) left out: busy work only
    busy = [o for o in samp if not sr.WAITING.search(sb(o[3][0]))]
    print(f'{len(samp)} samples, {len(busy)} busy (not waiting)')

    # leaf PCs in the main binary -> atos -i
    pcs = sorted({o[3][0] for o in busy if lo <= o[3][0] < hi})
    where = {}
    tmp = os.path.join(d, '_pcs.txt')
    with open(tmp, 'w') as f:
        for p in pcs:
            f.write('0x%x\n' % p)
    out = subprocess.run(['atos', '-i', '-o', binary, '-l', hex(lo), '-f', tmp], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    os.remove(tmp)
    # atos -i: one or more lines per address (inlined frames), a blank line between addresses
    groups = out.split('\n\n')
    if len(groups) < len(pcs):        # some versions print no blank line: one address per line
        groups = out.splitlines()
    for p, g in zip(pcs, groups):
        lines = [s for s in g.strip().splitlines() if s.strip()]
        shard = None
        for s in lines:          # the outermost (last) shard line = the lifted instruction
            mm = re.search(r'\((shard_\d+\.c):(\d+)\)', s)
            if mm:
                shard = (mm.group(1), int(mm.group(2)))
        inner = lines[0] if lines else ''
        helper = re.search(r'^(\S+) \(in .*?\) \((cpu\.h):(\d+)\)', inner)
        where[p] = (shard, helper.group(1) if helper else None)

    files = {}

    def insn_at(shard, line):
        if shard not in files:
            files[shard] = open(os.path.join(src, shard), errors='replace').read().split('\n')
        L = files[shard]
        for k in range(line - 1, max(-1, line - 60), -1):
            mm = INSN_RE.match(L[k])
            if mm:
                return int(mm.group(1), 16), mm.group(2), mm.group(3)
            if L[k].startswith('void sub_') or L[k].startswith('L_'):
                break
        return None, '(function entry/block)', ''

    kinds = collections.Counter(); mnem = collections.Counter(); helpers = collections.Counter()
    outside = collections.Counter(); addrs = collections.Counter()
    for o in busy:
        p = o[3][0]
        if not (lo <= p < hi):
            outside[sb(p)] += 1
            continue
        shard, helper = where.get(p, (None, None))
        if not shard:
            outside['(runtime) ' + sb(p)] += 1
            continue
        a, mn, ops = insn_at(*shard)
        k = category(mn, ops) if a is not None else mn
        kinds[k] += 1
        mnem[mn] += 1
        if a is not None:
            addrs[a] += 1
        if helper:
            helpers[helper] += 1
    N = len(busy)
    lifted = sum(kinds.values())
    print(f'\nin lifted code: {lifted} samples ({100 * lifted / N:.1f}% of busy); outside {N - lifted}')
    print('\n== x86 instruction kind (share within the lifted code) ==')
    for k, v in kinds.most_common():
        print(f'  {100 * v / lifted:5.1f}%  {k}')
    print('\n== most frequent instructions ==')
    for k, v in mnem.most_common(25):
        print(f'  {100 * v / lifted:5.1f}%  {k}')
    print('\n== inline helpers (cpu.h) ==')
    for k, v in helpers.most_common(12):
        print(f'  {100 * v / lifted:5.1f}%  {k}')
    print('\n== outside the lifted code (busy samples) ==')
    for k, v in outside.most_common(15):
        print(f'  {100 * v / N:5.1f}%  {k}')
    print('\n== hottest x86 addresses ==')
    for a, v in addrs.most_common(15):
        print(f'  {100 * v / lifted:5.2f}%  0x{a:08x}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

{"id": "AT001465", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/tools/lregs.py", "originalBytes": 8932, "originalSha256": "6e5abaf47491630215570c1a83dd2ea03dcd07a3176bdaf4f04c3bf632a30dd2", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 8932, "utf8TotalBytes": 8932}

"""LREGS: the guest's general registers and arithmetic flags as C locals of
each lifted function, stored to the CPU struct only where something else can
see them (tools/lift.py runs this on every function it lifts when LREGS=1).

The lifter's C reads and writes c->eax, c->zf, ... directly.  The CPU struct
outlives the function, so clang has to make every one of those stores: a flag
that only the next branch reads is still materialised and stored (cmp, cset,
str on arm64), and a register written in a loop is stored on every pass.
With LREGS the function keeps them in locals (_r_eax ... _r_of; cpu.h's RG_()
names them in the shared macros: PUSH32, POP32, FLAGS_*, CC_*, FCOMI) and
the struct is brought up to date at the points where code outside the
function can read or write it:
  - a direct call: the registers before it (the flags too when the callee
    reads flags at entry, FLAGABI's live_in), both reloaded after it;
  - an indirect call (DISPATCH_CALL, dispatch_indirect): the registers before
    it (an indirect callee reads no flags: the ABI FLAGABI already relies
    on), both reloaded after it;
  - a tail jump (DISPATCH_TAIL): registers and flags;
  - a return: the registers (the flags too in a function that returns flags,
    FLAGABI's flags_out);
  - the runtime helpers that take the CPU: cpuid_shim (registers),
    guest_hook and unsupported_insn (everything).  pushfd and popfd work on
    the locals (LR_EFLAGS_GET / LR_EFLAGS_SET).
Only what may have changed since the struct was last in step is stored: a
forward dataflow over the function's blocks (labels and gotos) tracks the
registers written since the entry or the last call on any path; the others
hold the struct's value already.  A reload that nothing reads is removed by
clang.  So every point where other code can look sees the same values as
before; in between, nothing else runs on this guest thread, and other threads
only see its CPU while it is inside such a call (the guest lock).  Without a
FLAGABI table every call and every return also stores the flags.
"""
import re

GPR = ('eax', 'ecx', 'edx', 'ebx', 'esp', 'ebp', 'esi', 'edi')
FLG = ('cf', 'pf', 'af', 'zf', 'sf', 'of')
GBIT = {r: 1 << i for i, r in enumerate(GPR)}
GMASK = 0xff
FBIT = 0x100                      # any of the six flags

_FIELD = re.compile(r'\bc->(eax|ecx|edx|ebx|esp|ebp|esi|edi|cf|pf|af|zf|sf|of)\b')
_HDR = re.compile(r'^void sub_([0-9a-f]{8})(?:_orig)?\(CPU \*(?:restrict )?c\) ?\{')
# the points where the struct must be in step, and what each needs
_SITES = [('call',  re.compile(r'\bsub_([0-9a-f]{8})\(c\);')),
          ('icall', re.compile(r'\bDISPATCH_CALL\(c, [^;]*?\);')),
          ('icall', re.compile(r'\bdispatch_indirect\(c, [^;]*?\);')),
          ('cpuid', re.compile(r'\bcpuid_shim\(c\);')),
          ('all',   re.compile(r'\bguest_hook\(c, [^;]*?\);')),
          ('all',   re.compile(r'\bunsupported_insn\(c, ?0x[0-9a-f]+u, ?"[^"]*"\);')),
          ('ret',   re.compile(r'\breturn;'))]
_EFGET = re.compile(r'\beflags_get\(c\)')
_EFSET = re.compile(r'\beflags_set\(c, ?([^;]*?)\);')
# writes: assignment and compound assignment, ++/--, the stack and flag macros
_WRITE = re.compile(r'\b_r_([a-z]{2,3})\s*(?:[-+*/%&|^]|<<|>>)?=(?!=)')
_INCDEC = re.compile(r'(?:\b_r_([a-z]{2,3})\s*(?:\+\+|--))|(?:(?:\+\+|--)\s*_r_([a-z]{2,3})\b)')
_ESPW = re.compile(r'\b(?:PUSH32|POP32)\(')
_FLAGW = re.compile(r'\b(?:FLAGS_[A-Z]+_M|SETZSP_M|SETZSP|FCOMI|LR_EFLAGS_SET)\(')
# cpu.h FTOL2_INL (the CRT's _ftol2 in place, lift option FTOL2INL): eax, ecx, edx, esp and flags
_FTOL2W = re.compile(r'\bFTOL2_INL\(')
_LABEL = re.compile(r'\bL_([0-9a-f]{8}):;')
_GOTO = re.compile(r'\bgoto L_([0-9a-f]{8});')

def _tail_end(body, j):
    """end of 'DISPATCH_TAIL(c, <expr>)' (and its ';') starting at j"""
    k = j + len('DISPATCH_TAIL('); depth = 1
    while depth:
        ch = body[k]
        if ch == '(': depth += 1
        elif ch == ')': depth -= 1
        k += 1
    if k < len(body) and body[k] == ';': k += 1
    return k

def transform(code, live_in=None, flags_out=None):
    """One lifted function (optional comment lines, the header, the body, the
    closing brace) -> its LREGS form.  live_in: entry -> flags read at entry,
    flags_out: the functions that return flags (FLAGABI); None: every callee
    reads and every function returns them."""
    lines = code.split('\n')
    m = None
    for hi, ln in enumerate(lines):
        m = _HDR.match(ln)
        if m: break
    if not m: return code
    ret_f = flags_out is None or int(m.group(1), 16) in flags_out
    head = '\n'.join(lines[:hi]) + ('\n' if hi else '')
    brace = lines[hi].index('{')
    sig = lines[hi][:brace + 1]
    body = lines[hi][brace + 1:] + ('\n' + '\n'.join(lines[hi + 1:]) if hi + 1 < len(lines) else '')
    end = body.rstrip().rfind('}')                # the function's closing brace
    tail, body = body[end:], body[:end]
    body = _FIELD.sub(r'_r_\1', body)
    body = _EFGET.sub('LR_EFLAGS_GET()', body)
    body = _EFSET.sub(lambda mm: f'LR_EFLAGS_SET({mm.group(1)});', body)

    def cond_at(pos):
        """a goto / return / tail jump at pos is conditional when its statement
        starts with if or a switch case"""
        t = body[body.rfind('\n', 0, pos) + 1:pos].lstrip()
        return t.startswith('if') or t.startswith('case')
    sites = []                                    # (start, end, kind, match)
    for kind, rx in _SITES:
        for mm in rx.finditer(body): sites.append((mm.start(), mm.end(), kind, mm))
    j = 0
    while (j := body.find('DISPATCH_TAIL(c,', j)) >= 0:
        k = _tail_end(body, j); sites.append((j, k, 'tail', None)); j = k
    sites.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    unc = [not cond_at(a) for (a, _b, _k, _m) in sites]
    ev = [(a, 2, 'site', i) for i, (a, _b, _k, _m) in enumerate(sites)]
    ev += [(mm.start(), 0, 'label', mm.group(1)) for mm in _LABEL.finditer(body)]
    for mm in _WRITE.finditer(body):
        r = mm.group(1)
        if r in GBIT: ev.append((mm.start(), 1, 'w', GBIT[r]))
        elif r in FLG: ev.append((mm.start(), 1, 'w', FBIT))
    ev += [(mm.start(), 1, 'w', GBIT[g]) for mm in _INCDEC.finditer(body) for g in mm.groups() if g in GBIT]
    ev += [(mm.start(), 1, 'w', GBIT['esp']) for mm in _ESPW.finditer(body)]
    ev += [(mm.start(), 1, 'w', FBIT) for mm in _FLAGW.finditer(body)]
    ev += [(mm.start(), 1, 'w', GBIT['eax'] | GBIT['ecx'] | GBIT['edx'] | GBIT['esp'] | FBIT) for mm in _FTOL2W.finditer(body)]
    ev += [(mm.start(), 3, 'goto', (mm.group(1), not cond_at(mm.start()))) for mm in _GOTO.finditer(body)]
    ev.sort(key=lambda e: (e[0], e[1]))

    # forward dataflow: what may differ from the struct (None: no path gets here)
    IN = {}; at = [0] * len(sites); cur = 0
    for _ in range(64):
        changed = False; cur = 0
        for _p, _o, kind, arg in ev:
            if kind == 'label':
                if cur is not None:
                    v = IN.get(arg, 0) | cur
                    if IN.get(arg) != v: IN[arg] = v; changed = True
                cur = IN.get(arg)
            elif cur is None: continue
            elif kind == 'w': cur |= arg
            elif kind == 'goto':
                t, u = arg
                v = IN.get(t, 0) | cur
                if IN.get(t) != v: IN[t] = v; changed = True
                if u: cur = None
            else:
                at[arg] = cur
                k = sites[arg][2]
                if k in ('call', 'icall', 'all'): cur = 0          # stored, then reloaded
                elif k == 'cpuid': cur &= ~GMASK
                elif unc[arg]: cur = None                           # ret, tail
        if not changed: break

    def store(mask, flags):
        g = [f'c->{r} = _r_{r};' for r in GPR if mask & GBIT[r]]
        f = [f'c->{x} = _r_{x};' for x in FLG] if flags and mask & FBIT else []
        return ' '.join(g + f)
    out = []; last = 0
    for i, (a, b, kind, mm) in enumerate(sites):
        d = at[i] or 0
        if kind == 'call':
            st = store(d, live_in is None or live_in.get(int(mm.group(1), 16), 0))
            rep = f'{body[a:b]} LR_FG; LR_FF;'
        elif kind == 'icall': st = store(d, False); rep = f'{body[a:b]} LR_FG; LR_FF;'
        elif kind == 'cpuid': st = store(d, False); rep = f'{body[a:b]} LR_FG;'
        elif kind == 'all':   st = store(d, True);  rep = f'{body[a:b]} LR_FG; LR_FF;'
        elif kind == 'ret':   st = store(d, ret_f); rep = 'return;'
        else:                 st = store(d, True);  rep = body[a:b].rstrip(';')
        out += [body[last:a], '{ ', st + ' ' if st else '', rep, ' }']; last = b
    out.append(body[last:])
    body = ''.join(out)
    # a body that ends without a return (the lift-error stubs) stores on the way out
    fall = store(cur or 0, ret_f) if cur is not None else ''
    return head + sig + ' LR_ENTER;' + body + (' ' + fall if fall else '') + ' ' + tail.lstrip()

SHARD_DEFINE = '#define NFSU2_LREGS 1\n'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Manifest of a directory tree, to prove a game folder was not touched.

  tools/manifest.py <dir> <out.tsv>          write the manifest
  tools/manifest.py --diff <a.tsv> <b.tsv>   compare two; exit 1 if they differ

One line per entry (files, directories, symlinks), sorted by relative path:
type, size, mtime and ctime (ns), mode, extended-attribute names, SHA-256
(files).  ctime moves on any metadata change (chmod, xattr, rename), mtime on
any content change, and a directory's mtime when an entry is added or
removed in it, so writes, creations, deletions and attribute changes all
show up.  Access times are left out: reading a file (this tool included) may
update them.  Only reads the tree.
"""
import ctypes, hashlib, os, stat, sys

_libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
_libc.listxattr.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int]
_libc.listxattr.restype = ctypes.c_ssize_t


def xattr_names(path):
    """Extended-attribute names (macOS listxattr, XATTR_NOFOLLOW)."""
    p = os.fsencode(path)
    n = _libc.listxattr(p, None, 0, 1)
    if n <= 0:
        return [] if n == 0 else ['?']
    buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(n)
    n = _libc.listxattr(p, buf, n, 1)
    return [x.decode('utf-8', 'replace') for x in buf.raw[:max(n, 0)].split(b'\0') if x]


def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        while True:
            b = f.read(1 << 20)
            if not b:
                break
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def entry(root, p):
    st = os.lstat(p)
    if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
        kind, size, digest = 'd', 0, '-'
    elif stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
        kind, size, digest = 'l', st.st_size, os.readlink(p)
    else:
        kind, size, digest = 'f', st.st_size, sha256(p)
    xa = ','.join(sorted(xattr_names(p))) or '-'
    return (os.path.relpath(p, root), kind, size, st.st_mtime_ns, st.st_ctime_ns,
            '%o' % st.st_mode, xa, digest)


def entries(root):
    yield entry(root, root)
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        dirnames.sort()
        for name in sorted(dirnames + filenames):
            yield entry(root, os.path.join(dirpath, name))


def write(root, out):
    n = total = 0
    with open(out, 'w') as f:
        f.write('# manifest of %s\n# path\ttype\tsize\tmtime_ns\tctime_ns\tmode\txattrs\tsha256\n' % os.path.abspath(root))
        for e in entries(root):
            f.write('\t'.join(str(x) for x in e) + '\n')
            n += 1
            total += e[2] if e[1] == 'f' else 0
    print('manifest: %d entries, %.2f GB of files -> %s' % (n, total / 1e9, out))


def load(path):
    rows = {}
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('#'):
                continue
            c = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
            rows[c[0]] = c[1:]
    return rows


def diff(a, b):
    ra, rb = load(a), load(b)
    cols = ['type', 'size', 'mtime_ns', 'ctime_ns', 'mode', 'xattrs', 'sha256']
    changes = []
    for p in sorted(set(ra) | set(rb)):
        if p not in rb:
            changes.append('removed  %s' % p)
        elif p not in ra:
            changes.append('added    %s' % p)
        elif ra[p] != rb[p]:
            what = [cols[i] for i in range(len(cols)) if ra[p][i] != rb[p][i]]
            changes.append('changed  %s  (%s)' % (p, ', '.join(what)))
    print('manifest diff: %d entries before, %d after, %d differences' % (len(ra), len(rb), len(changes)))
    for c in changes[:200]:
        print('  ' + c)
    return 1 if changes else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) == 4 and sys.argv[1] == '--diff':
        sys.exit(diff(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]))
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    write(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Where the game's World Map jumps a car to in free roam, for the server's cheat watch:
web/server-rs/crates/roam/src/jumps.rs.

  tools/map_jumps.py <game>/TRACKS/ROUTESL4RA/PathsFreeRoam.bin > web/server-rs/crates/roam/src/jumps.rs

The map's jump moves the car within free roam, with no loading screen: onto an event's trigger (marker type 13, a
race's start), or beside a shop's, the garage's or the car lot's (type 14: 15 m beside most, 39 m beside one).  The
two kinds go into two tables, for the watch takes a shop's landing farther off.  The markers are the file's
chunk 0x3414A, variable-size records (+0 type, +4 x, +8 y, +0x42 the record's size).  Only their places go into the
table, no game data.
"""
import sys, struct

TYPES = {13: 'event', 14: 'shop'}

def markers(b):
    o = 8
    while o + 8 <= len(b):
        cid, size = struct.unpack_from('<II', b, o)
        if cid == 0x3414A:
            p, end = o + 8, o + 8 + size
            while p + 0x44 <= end:
                t, x, y = struct.unpack_from('<Iff', b, p)
                n, = struct.unpack_from('<h', b, p + 0x42)
                if n <= 0: break
                yield t, x, y
                p += n
            return
        o += 8 + size
    sys.exit('no marker chunk (0x3414A) in this file')

def table(name, rows, out):
    out.append(f'pub(crate) const {name}: [(f64, f64); {len(rows)}] = [')
    line = '   '
    for x, y in rows:
        item = f' ({x}.0, {y}.0),'
        if len(line) + len(item) > 120:
            out.append(line); line = '   '
        line += item
    out += [line, '];']

def main():
    b = open(sys.argv[1], 'rb').read()
    rows = sorted({(t, round(x), round(y)) for t, x, y in markers(b) if t in TYPES})
    if not rows: sys.exit('no event or shop triggers in this file')
    out = ['//! Where the game\'s World Map jumps a car to in free roam (watch.rs), x and y (m): the event triggers (a race\'s',
           '//! start, where the jump puts the car) and the shops\' triggers (the garage\'s and the car lot\'s too; it puts the car',
           '//! 15 m beside most of them, 39 m beside one).  Made by tools/map_jumps.py from the game\'s',
           '//! TRACKS/ROUTESL4RA/PathsFreeRoam.bin; do not edit.']
    for t, name in ((13, 'EVENTS'), (14, 'SHOPS')):
        out.append('')
        table(name, [(x, y) for k, x, y in rows if k == t], out)
    print('\n'.join(out))
    counts = {TYPES[t]: sum(r[0] == t for r in rows) for t in TYPES}
    print(f'{len(rows)} triggers: {counts}', file=sys.stderr)

main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mock Discord desktop IPC server for testing runtime/discord.c (never the real client).

    tools/mock_discord.py <socket path> [--log frames.jsonl] [--mode MODE] [--duration S]
                          [--ping S] [--reply-delay S]

Listens on a Unix socket like the Discord app's discord-ipc-N and speaks its
framing: 8-byte little-endian header {opcode, length} + UTF-8 JSON.  Every
frame in both directions goes to the log as one JSON object per line:
    {"t": <seconds since start>, "conn": N, "dir": "in"|"out"|"event", "op": OP, "json": <payload>}
"json" is the decoded payload, or {"_raw": "..."} when it was not valid JSON
(a test treats that as a failure).  Checks Discord's own limits as it goes and
logs "event" lines for violations (rate limit, field lengths, forbidden fields).

Modes (how the server misbehaves):
    normal     handshake -> READY, SET_ACTIVITY -> reply (default)
    noready    accept the handshake, never answer (client must time out)
    close      close the socket right after the handshake
    garbage    answer the handshake with random bytes and an absurd header
    slow       answer nothing for --reply-delay seconds, and do not read meanwhile
    error      READY, then an ERROR reply to every SET_ACTIVITY
    badid      CLOSE {code 4000, "Invalid Client ID"} after the handshake
    noread     READY, then never read again while sending a 1.5 KB PING every
               10 ms: the client's PONGs fill the socket buffer (its writes
               block); it must drop the connection without stalling the game
--ping S: also send a PING every S seconds (the client must answer PONG).
--rate-n/--rate-window: the rate limit to check (Discord: 5 per 20 s).
SIGTERM/SIGINT: stop, writing a final {"dir":"event","what":"exit"} line.
"""
import argparse, json, os, random, selectors, signal, socket, struct, sys, time

OPS = {0: 'HANDSHAKE', 1: 'FRAME', 2: 'CLOSE', 3: 'PING', 4: 'PONG'}


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('path')
    ap.add_argument('--log')
    ap.add_argument('--mode', default='normal',
                    choices=['normal', 'noready', 'close', 'garbage', 'slow', 'error', 'badid', 'noread'])
    ap.add_argument('--duration', type=float, default=0)
    ap.add_argument('--ping', type=float, default=0)
    ap.add_argument('--reply-delay', type=float, default=8.0)
    ap.add_argument('--rate-n', type=int, default=5, help="Discord's limit: N SET_ACTIVITY ...")
    ap.add_argument('--rate-window', type=float, default=20.0, help='... per this many seconds')
    a = ap.parse_args()

    t0 = time.monotonic()
    logf = open(a.log, 'a', buffering=1) if a.log else None

    def log(**kw):
        kw['t'] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 3)
        line = json.dumps(kw, ensure_ascii=False)
        if logf: logf.write(line + '\n')
        else: print(line, flush=True)

    try: os.unlink(a.path)
    except FileNotFoundError: pass
    ls = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    ls.bind(a.path); ls.listen(4); ls.setblocking(False)
    sel = selectors.DefaultSelector()
    sel.register(ls, selectors.EVENT_READ, None)
    log(dir='event', what='listening', path=a.path, mode=a.mode)

    stop = [False]
    def on_sig(*_): stop[0] = True
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, on_sig); signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, on_sig)

    conns = {}           # sock -> state
    nconn = [0]
    sets = []            # times of SET_ACTIVITY (for the rate check, across connections like Discord)

    def send(s, st, op, obj=None, raw=None):
        body = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(obj, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
        try: s.sendall(struct.pack('<II', op, len(body)) + body)
        except OSError: return
        log(conn=st['id'], dir='out', op=op, json=obj if raw is None else {'_raw': body[:64].hex()})

    def drop(s, why):
        st = conns.pop(s, None)
        try: sel.unregister(s)
        except Exception: pass
        s.close()
        if st: log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='closed', why=why)

    def check_activity(st, j):
        args = j.get('args') if isinstance(j, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(args, dict) or not isinstance(args.get('pid'), int):
            log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation', why='args.pid missing or not an int')
        if not isinstance(j.get('nonce'), str) or not j.get('nonce'):
            log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation', why='nonce missing')
        act = (args or {}).get('activity')
        if act is None: return
        for k in ('details', 'state'):
            if k in act:
                v = act[k]
                if not isinstance(v, str) or not (2 <= len(v) <= 128):
                    log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation', why=f'{k} length {len(v) if isinstance(v, str) else v!r}')
        for k in ('buttons', 'party', 'secrets', 'match', 'join', 'spectate'):
            if k in act:
                log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation', why=f'forbidden field {k}')
        ts = act.get('timestamps', {}).get('start')
        if ts is not None and not (1.5e9 < ts < 4e9):
            log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation', why=f'timestamps.start {ts} not Unix seconds')

    def handle(s, st, op, body):
        try:
            j = json.loads(body.decode('utf-8'))
        except Exception:
            log(conn=st['id'], dir='in', op=op, json={'_raw': body[:200].hex()})
            log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation', why='payload is not valid UTF-8 JSON')
            return
        log(conn=st['id'], dir='in', op=op, json=j)
        if op == 0:
            st['hs'] = True
            if a.mode == 'noready': return
            if a.mode == 'close': drop(s, 'mode close'); return
            if a.mode == 'badid':
                send(s, st, 2, {'code': 4000, 'message': 'Invalid Client ID'}); drop(s, 'mode badid'); return
            if a.mode == 'garbage':
                send(s, st, 1, raw=bytes(random.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(40)))
                try: s.sendall(struct.pack('<II', 77, 0x7fffffff) + b'\xff' * 32)
                except OSError: pass
                log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='sent garbage')
                return
            if a.mode == 'slow':
                st['mute_until'] = time.monotonic() + a.reply_delay
                st['pending'].append((1, ready_payload()))
                return
            send(s, st, 1, ready_payload())
            if a.mode == 'noread':
                st['noread'] = True
                try: sel.unregister(s)                      # never read from it again
                except Exception: pass
                log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='stopped reading')
        elif op == 1:
            if j.get('cmd') == 'SET_ACTIVITY':
                now = time.monotonic()
                sets.append(now)
                recent = [x for x in sets if now - x < a.rate_window]
                if len(recent) > a.rate_n:
                    log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation',
                        why=f'rate: {len(recent)} SET_ACTIVITY in {a.rate_window:g} s')
                check_activity(st, j)
                if a.mode == 'error':
                    send(s, st, 1, {'cmd': 'SET_ACTIVITY', 'evt': 'ERROR', 'nonce': j.get('nonce'),
                                    'data': {'code': 4002, 'message': 'child "activity" fails because [mock]'}})
                else:
                    send(s, st, 1, {'cmd': 'SET_ACTIVITY', 'evt': None, 'nonce': j.get('nonce'),
                                    'data': (j.get('args') or {}).get('activity')})
        elif op == 2:
            drop(s, 'client CLOSE')
        elif op == 3:
            send(s, st, 4, j)
        elif op == 4:
            st['pongs'] += 1

    def ready_payload():
        return {'cmd': 'DISPATCH', 'evt': 'READY', 'nonce': None,
                'data': {'v': 1, 'config': {'cdn_host': 'cdn.discordapp.com', 'api_endpoint': '//discord.com/api',
                                            'environment': 'production'},
                         'user': {'id': '1', 'username': 'mock-user-secret', 'discriminator': '0', 'avatar': None}}}

    last_ping = time.monotonic()
    while not stop[0]:
        if a.duration and time.monotonic() - t0 > a.duration: break
        for key, _ in sel.select(timeout=0.1):
            if key.data is None:
                try: c, _ = ls.accept()
                except BlockingIOError: continue
                c.setblocking(False)
                nconn[0] += 1
                conns[c] = {'id': nconn[0], 'buf': b'', 'hs': False, 'pongs': 0, 'mute_until': 0, 'pending': []}
                sel.register(c, selectors.EVENT_READ, 'c')
                log(conn=nconn[0], dir='event', what='accepted')
                continue
            s = key.fileobj; st = conns.get(s)
            if not st: continue
            if time.monotonic() < st['mute_until']: continue      # "slow": do not read
            try: d = s.recv(65536)
            except BlockingIOError: continue
            except OSError: d = b''
            if not d: drop(s, 'client closed'); continue
            st['buf'] += d
            while len(st['buf']) >= 8 and s in conns:
                op, ln = struct.unpack_from('<II', st['buf'])
                if ln > 1 << 20:
                    log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='violation', why=f'absurd length {ln}'); drop(s, 'bad frame'); break
                if len(st['buf']) < 8 + ln: break
                body = st['buf'][8:8 + ln]; st['buf'] = st['buf'][8 + ln:]
                handle(s, st, op, body)
        now = time.monotonic()
        for s, st in list(conns.items()):
            if st['pending'] and now >= st['mute_until']:
                for op, obj in st['pending']: send(s, st, op, obj)
                st['pending'] = []
        for s, st in list(conns.items()):
            if st.get('noread') and now - st.get('last_flood', 0) >= 0.01:
                st['last_flood'] = now
                body = json.dumps({'flood': 'x' * 1500}).encode()
                try: s.send(struct.pack('<II', 3, len(body)) + body); st['flood'] = st.get('flood', 0) + 1
                except BlockingIOError: pass
                except OSError:
                    log(conn=st['id'], dir='event', what='flood ended', pings=st.get('flood', 0)); drop(s, 'peer gone')
        if a.ping and now - last_ping >= a.ping:
            last_ping = now
            for s, st in list(conns.items()):
                if st['hs'] and a.mode in ('normal', 'error'): send(s, st, 3, {'ping': int(now * 1000)})
    for s in list(conns): drop(s, 'server exit')
    try: os.unlink(a.path)
    except FileNotFoundError: pass
    log(dir='event', what='exit')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The mod packs: MODPACKS/ in the game folder, what community mods add to the
game (new parts and their files), for every player alike.  Everyone's game
loads all of it, so a friend's car with a mod's part looks the same on every
screen; each mod's switch (a settings.ini key) only decides whether its parts
are offered in the shops (runtime/modpacks.c).

    tools/modpacks.py <game folder> --mod <mod folder> [--brands BLITZ,...] [--out <folder>]

<mod folder> is the PC mod with the rims, extracted: the folder with
"1 - Mod Files" in it, or that folder itself.  Of it, only the rim brands named (default: BLITZ)
are taken, each with all of its rims: their parts in the mod's car part
database, the brand's model pack, the rims' textures and the brand's icon.
Nothing the mod changes in the game's own parts is taken: the mod also takes
out some of the game's rims and brands, which stay here.

What it writes under <out> (default: the game folder):
  MODPACKS/PARTS.BIN        the parts, for runtime/modpacks.c (below)
  MODPACKS/CARS/WHEELS/GEOMETRY_<BRAND>.BIN   a new brand's model pack, the mod's file as it is
  MODPACKS/CARS/WHEELS/TEXTURES.BIN           what the game's CARS/WHEELS/TEXTURES.BIN gains: the
                            rims' textures and the brands' icons, a pack as tools/vinylpacks.py makes
                            them ('VPAK', read by runtime/fileio.c)
  MODPACKS/GLOBAL/GLOBALTEXTURES{NA,ROW}.BIN  the brands' icons (the rim shop's brand list), in the texture
                            packs the game keeps loaded whole (a VPAK each)
  MODPACKS/GLOBAL/GlobalMemoryFile.bin        the game's memory file without that file's header (a
                            VPAK too): the game keeps the header of CARS/WHEELS/TEXTURES.BIN in it, and
                            would read the textures' list from there, without the new ones

PARTS.BIN (little-endian):
  header   'MPRT', version 1, mods, parts, texts, strings' size, 0, 0
  mods     32 bytes each: the settings.ini key's environment name (NFSU2_...) that switches the mod's
           parts on in the shops
  parts    PART_SZ bytes each (the last word: the stand-in, a game part's key, 0 the slot's stock part):
           key, kind, category and level (the game's byte), its +6 byte, mod (index),
           owner (bStringHash of it), name, the model record (its first two bytes, 1 if the part has one, 0,
           base name, 8 names),
           attributes (count, then 8 of {hash, value})
  texts    {hash, string}: texts the game's language table gains (a brand's name)
  strings  NUL-terminated; a part's strings are offsets into them, 0xFFFFFFFF none
Every string a part names is an offset into strings; runtime/modpacks.c puts
them into the part database's own string table.

All of it is checked as the game reads it (tools/packcheck.py) before any of
it is written; nothing is written when a file fails.
"""
