{"id": "AT001534", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/web/server-rs/crates/bans/src/lib.rs", "originalBytes": 42007, "originalSha256": "a536a205b91c1d1fb282cde8ea41f97258b80c966771f75189ba5c9df698e4f6", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 42007, "utf8TotalBytes": 42007}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//! The operator's bans (the server's control socket: `nfsu2-server ctl ban ...`): who may not play with others, or not
//! race them, for a while or for good, and the message their page shows them (nfsu2-lan's Kicks and bans).  The names
//! the operator took away (`rename`).  What each player had before, for a year ([`PAST_MS`]).  And the marks of the
//! players a `[cheat]` line of a race names: a handle (`c17`) that `ban` takes for [`MARK_MS`] (7 days), long after
//! the player left (`Bans::mark`).
//!
//! A ban is of a [`Kind`]: a full one turns the player's connections away (free roam, Online, LAN: the bans from
//! before kinds, and an entry of the file without one); a race ban lets the player play on with others but never race
//! them (the switch drops its LAN play and its free-roam lobby and outrun messages, the Online lobby refuses it a
//! game); a rename takes the player's name away from everyone (the name goes on the names taken away, `Bans::deny`,
//! and the player picks another) and is in force no longer than that moment: it is the player's history.
//!
//! There are no accounts, so a ban names a client the three ways the server knows one, each as a keyed hash
//! (HMAC-SHA256 under `bans.key` in the state folder, base64url, 22 characters): `bans.json` holds no address, no id
//! and no keyphrase's owner, and means nothing without the key.
//!
//! - Its address, as the server's limits count it (an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 /56), for at most [`ADDR_MS`] (7 days)
//!   after it was last the banned player's, at most [`ADDRS_MAX`] of them: addresses change hands (a phone network
//!   gives many players one address in turn, a home's address goes to another home), and a VPN's server, iCloud
//!   Private Relay's and a school's are many players' at once.  So an address alone never turns anyone away: whoever
//!   comes from it races nobody, and its page says why (someone who played from its network was banned) and what to
//!   do (another network, the VPN off).  A player who keeps hopping from one VPN server to the next would only take
//!   more strangers' races away: past [`ADDRS_MAX`] the ban takes in no more.
//! - The id its page keeps in the browser's storage (the hello's "id", web/src/app/page-id.ts), for as long as the ban
//!   lasts.  A page that found another id in its other store names that one too (the hello's "was").
//! - The keyphrase its page plays with (the one that keeps its cloud saves and claims its name), by the owner
//!   nfsu2-claims makes of its token (the switch's `AttachOpts::on_claim`), for as long as the ban lasts: the same on
//!   every device and browser the player types it into.
//!
//! A hello that matches a full ban by its page ids or keyphrase is turned away ([`Bans::by_hello`]); one that matches
//! a race ban that way, or any ban by its address only ([`Match::Addr`]), races nobody.  A ban made with an address
//! alone (a tool's, without a page id) names it by that, as by its own keys.  A hello that matches by what
//! the ban was made with (the player's page ids and keyphrase then) adds what else it names: its address (as above),
//! and its other page ids and keyphrase, each for [`LINK_MS`] (30 days) after it was last seen with one of those, at
//! most [`KEYS_MAX`] of each (the first ones stay).  So the player's new browser is turned away while it keeps showing
//! up with the banned keyphrase, and a month after.  A hello that matches only by what was added so is turned away
//! and adds nothing: a keyphrase the player typed into someone else's browser bans that browser for a month at most,
//! and never its owner's own keyphrase or address.  An address never adds anything (whoever shares it would be
//! banned).  None of it stops a player who clears the site's data, leaves its keyphrase (and its cloud saves and its
//! name) behind and changes networks: without accounts no ban can.
//!
//! A new ban takes the place of the bans of its kind that name one of the same page ids or keyphrases (for a player
//! without either: the same address), so `ban Bob perm` after `ban Bob 1d` leaves one ban, for good; a race ban and a
//! full ban of one player both stand (the full one ends, the race ban goes on).  A ban whose time is up, one lifted
//! and one replaced go to the player's history (`Bans::history`), kept [`PAST_MS`] after it ended; so do renames.
//! What is over goes at the next change or listing; so do marks.  The file is written whole: a temporary file beside
//! it (0600), synced, renamed over it.  A server from before kinds reads a race ban as a full one (its file has no kind).

use std::io::{self, Read, Write};
use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;

use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};
use parking_lot::Mutex;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{Map, Value};
use sha2::Sha256;

/// how long an address stays banned after it was last the banned player's (ms)
pub const ADDR_MS: i64 = 7 * DAY;
/// how long a page id or keyphrase a ban took in later stays banned after it was last seen with the ban's own (ms)
pub const LINK_MS: i64 = 30 * DAY;
/// how long a `[cheat]` line's mark lasts after its last line (ms)
pub const MARK_MS: i64 = 7 * DAY;
/// how long a ban that ended, and a rename, stay in the player's history (ms)
pub const PAST_MS: i64 = 365 * DAY;
/// the longest message a kick or a ban carries (characters)
pub const MSG_MAX: usize = 200;
/// the longest ban short of one for good (ms): ten years
pub const FOR_MAX: i64 = 3650 * DAY;
/// the most page ids, and keyphrases, a ban takes in later, or a mark names: past them a hello adds none (a player
/// who keeps clearing its storage, or a script making up ids, does not grow the file without end; the first stay)
pub const KEYS_MAX: usize = 32;
/// the most addresses a ban names at once (the latest a new one is made with, then the first a hello brings in; one
/// whose time is up makes room)
pub const ADDRS_MAX: usize = 3;
/// the most marks kept (the oldest go first)
const MARKS_MAX: usize = 5000;
/// the most bans kept in the history (the oldest go first), and names taken away
const PAST_MAX: usize = 20_000;
const NAMES_MAX: usize = 10_000;
/// the most names of earlier lines a mark keeps, and bans (the latest stay)
const MARK_NAMES_MAX: usize = 8;
/// a key seen again this soon after its time was last set is not written again
const SLACK: i64 = 3_600_000;
const MIN: i64 = 60_000;
const HOUR: i64 = 60 * MIN;
const DAY: i64 = 24 * HOUR;

/// What a ban takes away (the crate doc)
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum Kind {
    /// playing with others at all: its connections are turned away
    #[default]
    Full,
    /// racing others: Online's games, free roam's lobby races and outruns, LAN play
    Races,
    /// its name (`Bans::rename`): in force no longer than that moment
    Name,
}

impl Kind {
    /// for the operator: "ban", "race ban", "rename"
    pub fn word(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Kind::Full => "ban",
            Kind::Races => "race ban",
            Kind::Name => "rename",
        }
    }
}

/// One ban.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Ban {
    /// its number (`unban #4`)
    pub id: u64,
    /// what it takes away (a file from before kinds: full bans)
    #[serde(default)]
    pub kind: Kind,
    /// the player's name when it was banned, for the operator (anyone can take any name: a ban never matches by one)
    pub name: String,
    /// what the player's page shows
    #[serde(default)]
    pub msg: String,
    /// when it was made, and until when it lasts (ms since 1970; None: for good)
    pub at: i64,
    pub until: Option<i64>,
    /// the hashes of the page ids and keyphrases (their owners: nfsu2-claims) it was made with, for as long as it lasts
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pages: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub owners: Vec<String>,
    /// and of the ones it took in later (`Bans::by_hello`), each until its own time
    #[serde(default)]
    pub later_pages: Vec<Held>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub later_owners: Vec<Held>,
    /// and of its addresses, each until its own time
    #[serde(default)]
    pub addrs: Vec<Held>,
}

/// A key a ban names until its own time, never past the ban's end: an address (`ADDR_MS` after it was last seen as
/// the player's), or a page id or keyphrase it took in later (`LINK_MS` after it was last seen with the ban's own)
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Held {
    /// its hash
    pub h: String,
    /// until when (ms since 1970)
    pub until: i64,
}

/// How a ban names a client: by what its player plays with (`Own`: its page ids, its keyphrase; or the address of a
/// ban made with an address alone), or by the address it comes from only (`Addr`: a VPN's server, a phone network, a
/// home: someone else's ban, as likely as not), which keeps it out of races and never turns it away
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Match {
    Own,
    Addr,
}

impl Ban {
    /// whether it is in force now (a rename never is)
    pub fn live(&self, now: i64) -> bool {
        self.kind != Kind::Name && self.until.is_none_or(|u| u > now)
    }
    /// Its page's control message for a client it names as `m` says: {"t":"ban",...} for a full ban by the player's
    /// own keys, else {"t":"races",...}; with its number, the player's name then, when it was made (ms since 1970),
    /// the operator's message, its end (none: for good) and, by the address only, "addr":true (the page says that
    /// someone who played from its network was banned)
    pub fn message(&self, m: Match) -> String {
        let mut o = Map::new();
        let full = self.kind == Kind::Full && m == Match::Own;
        o.insert("t".into(), if full { "ban" } else { "races" }.into());
        o.insert("id".into(), self.id.into());
        o.insert("name".into(), clean_msg(&self.name).into());
        o.insert("at".into(), self.at.into());
        o.insert("msg".into(), self.msg.clone().into());
        if let Some(u) = self.until {
            o.insert("until".into(), u.into());
        }
        if m == Match::Addr {
            o.insert("addr".into(), true.into());
        }
        Value::Object(o).to_string()
    }
    /// whether it was made with an address alone (no page id, no keyphrase: a tool's): the address is its own key
    fn addr_only(&self) -> bool {
        self.pages.is_empty() && self.owners.is_empty()
    }
    /// how it names a client of this address (its hash) now, if it does
    fn at_addr_as(&self, a: &str, now: i64) -> Option<Match> {
        self.at_addr(a, now).then_some(if self.addr_only() { Match::Own } else { Match::Addr })
    }
    /// whether it was made with one of these page ids or keyphrases (their hashes)
    fn made_for(&self, pages: &[String], owners: &[String]) -> bool {
        pages.iter().any(|p| self.pages.contains(p)) || owners.iter().any(|o| self.owners.contains(o))
    }
    /// whether it took in one of them later, and holds it now
    fn took_in(&self, pages: &[String], owners: &[String], now: i64) -> bool {
        let held = |l: &[Held], h: &String| l.iter().any(|x| &x.h == h && x.until > now);
        pages.iter().any(|p| held(&self.later_pages, p)) || owners.iter().any(|o| held(&self.later_owners, o))
    }
    /// whether it names this address (its hash) now
    fn at_addr(&self, a: &str, now: i64) -> bool {
        self.addrs.iter().any(|x| x.h == a && x.until > now)
    }
    /// until when a key it holds for `ms` from now lasts: never past its own end
    fn until_for(&self, ms: i64, now: i64) -> i64 {
        self.until.map_or(now + ms, |u| u.min(now + ms))
    }
    /// every key it named, whatever their time (the player's history)
    pub fn keys(&self) -> Keys {
        let hs = |l: &[Held]| l.iter().map(|x| x.h.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        Keys {
            addrs: hs(&self.addrs),
            pages: self.pages.iter().cloned().chain(hs(&self.later_pages)).collect(),
            owners: self.owners.iter().cloned().chain(hs(&self.later_owners)).collect(),
        }
    }
}

/// How a ban in the history ended (`Past`)
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum How {
    /// its time was up (a rename: made)
    Over,
    /// the operator lifted it (`unban`)
    Lifted,
    /// a new ban of its kind took its place (`Past::by`)
    Replaced,
}

/// A ban that ended, or a rename, in its player's history for `PAST_MS` after `ended`
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Past {
    pub ban: Ban,
    /// when it ended (ms since 1970), and how
    pub ended: i64,
    pub how: How,
    /// the ban that took its place
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub by: Option<u64>,
}

/// One of a player's bans (`Bans::history`): in force, or in the history
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Record {
    pub ban: Ban,
    /// None: in force
    pub past: Option<(i64, How, Option<u64>)>,
}

/// A name the operator took away (`Bans::rename`), from everyone, for good (`unname` gives it back)
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Denied {
    /// as the player had it
    pub name: String,
    pub at: i64,
    /// the rename's number
    pub by: u64,
}

/// What a hello's player is under (`Bans::by_hello`): the full ban that turns it away, the ban that keeps it out of
/// races and how it names the player (a race ban by its own keys first, else any ban by its address only); each the
/// one that lasts longest
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Verdict {
    pub full: Option<Ban>,
    pub races: Option<(Ban, Match)>,
}

/// Whom a ban or a mark names: the keyed hashes of addresses (`Bans::addr`), page ids and keyphrases (`Bans::keys`)
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Keys {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub addrs: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pages: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub owners: Vec<String>,
}

impl Keys {
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.addrs.is_empty() && self.pages.is_empty() && self.owners.is_empty()
    }
    /// another's added, each once, at most `KEYS_MAX` of each
    pub fn extend(&mut self, o: Keys) {
        for (to, from) in [(&mut self.addrs, o.addrs), (&mut self.pages, o.pages), (&mut self.owners, o.owners)] {
            for h in from {
                if !to.contains(&h) && to.len() < KEYS_MAX {
                    to.push(h);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    /// whether they name one of the same page ids or keyphrases (for keys without either: one of the same addresses)
    pub fn same_player(&self, o: &Keys) -> bool {
        if self.pages.is_empty() && self.owners.is_empty() {
            return self.addrs.iter().any(|a| o.addrs.contains(a));
        }
        self.pages.iter().any(|p| o.pages.contains(p)) || self.owners.iter().any(|x| o.owners.contains(x))
    }
}

/// a kick's control message: {"t":"kick","msg":...}
pub fn kick_message(msg: &str) -> String {
    let mut m = Map::new();
    m.insert("t".into(), "kick".into());
    m.insert("msg".into(), clean_msg(msg).into());
    Value::Object(m).to_string()
}

/// a rename's control message, which the page shows before it asks for another name: {"t":"rename","name":...,"msg":...}
pub fn rename_message(name: &str, msg: &str) -> String {
    let mut m = Map::new();
    m.insert("t".into(), "rename".into());
    m.insert("name".into(), clean_msg(name).into());
    m.insert("msg".into(), clean_msg(msg).into());
    Value::Object(m).to_string()
}

/// a race ban lifted while its player plays: {"t":"races","lifted":true}
pub fn races_lifted_message() -> String {
    r#"{"t":"races","lifted":true}"#.to_string()
}

/// What a hello names its client by (`Bans::by_hello`): its page's ids (the one it plays with, then the ones the page
/// found besides it), the owner of the keyphrase it plays with (nfsu2-claims), its address's hash (`Bans::addr`)
pub struct Seen<'a> {
    pub pages: &'a [&'a str],
    pub owner: Option<&'a str>,
    pub addr: Option<&'a str>,
}

/// A `[cheat]` line's mark (`Bans::mark`): the player the line named, for `ban c<n>`
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Mark {
    pub n: u64,
    /// the player's name at its last line, and when that was (ms since 1970)
    pub name: String,
    pub at: i64,
    pub keys: Keys,
    /// the other names its earlier lines gave it (each once, oldest first)
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub before: Vec<String>,
    /// the bans made of the player since its first line (`Bans::add`: by the handle, or by its name or address)
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub bans: Vec<u64>,
}

/// What a `[cheat]` line of a race says of its player (`Bans::mark`): its handle, the other names of its earlier lines
/// (oldest first), and the bans made of it since its first line, each with whether it is in force and its kind
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Marked {
    pub handle: String,
    pub before: Vec<String>,
    pub bans: Vec<(u64, bool, Kind)>,
}

impl Mark {
    /// its handle: "c17"
    pub fn handle(&self) -> String {
        format!("c{}", self.n)
    }
}

#[derive(Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct File {
    /// the last ban's number (renames count too)
    next: u64,
    bans: Vec<Ban>,
    /// the last mark's number, and the marks
    #[serde(default)]
    next_mark: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    marks: Vec<Mark>,
    /// the bans that ended and the renames, oldest first
    #[serde(default)]
    past: Vec<Past>,
    /// the names taken away, oldest first
    #[serde(default)]
    names: Vec<Denied>,
}

/// The bans of a state folder.  Every call takes one lock; the ones that change something write the file under it
/// (rare: the operator's commands, a banned player in a new browser, with a new keyphrase or at a new address, and a
/// `[cheat]` line of a race).
pub struct Bans {
    path: PathBuf,
    key: Vec<u8>,
    file: Mutex<File>,
    deny: Arc<nfsu2_names::Deny>,
}

impl Bans {
    /// The bans in `dir` (bans.json, and its key bans.key, made at the first start).  Err: a file that cannot be read.
    pub fn open(dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Bans> {
        let key = load_key(&dir.join("bans.key"))?;
        let path = dir.join("bans.json");
        let file: File = match std::fs::read(&path) {
            Ok(b) => serde_json::from_slice(&b).map_err(|e| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, e))?,
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => File::default(),
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        };
        let mut file = file;
        // a ban from before ADDRS_MAX: its latest addresses
        for b in &mut file.bans {
            latest_addrs(&mut b.addrs);
        }
        let deny = Arc::new(nfsu2_names::Deny::default());
        deny.set(file.names.iter().map(|d| d.name.clone()));
        Ok(Bans { path, key, file: Mutex::new(file), deny })
    }

    /// the names taken away, as the switch, the Online lobby and free roam's hub look them up (it follows every change)
    pub fn deny(&self) -> Arc<nfsu2_names::Deny> {
        self.deny.clone()
    }

    /// an address's hash: what bans name it by, and what the switch keeps of it (`AttachOpts::ident`)
    pub fn addr(&self, key: &str) -> String {
        self.hash("addr", key)
    }

    /// a player's keys as the switch knows them: its address's hash (`Bans::addr`), its page's id and its keyphrase's
    /// owner as they came
    pub fn keys(&self, addr: Option<&str>, page: Option<&str>, owner: Option<&str>) -> Keys {
        Keys {
            addrs: addr.map(str::to_string).into_iter().collect(),
            pages: page.map(|p| self.page(p)).into_iter().collect(),
            owners: owner.map(|o| self.owner(o)).into_iter().collect(),
        }
    }

    fn page(&self, id: &str) -> String {
        self.hash("page", id)
    }

    fn owner(&self, owner: &str) -> String {
        self.hash("owner", owner)
    }

    fn hash(&self, kind: &str, v: &str) -> String {
        let mut mac = <Hmac<Sha256> as Mac>::new_from_slice(&self.key).expect("HMAC takes any key");
        mac.update(kind.as_bytes());
        mac.update(b"\0");
        mac.update(v.as_bytes());
        nfsu2_util::js::base64url(&mac.finalize().into_bytes())[..22].to_string()
    }

    /// The live bans a hello's page ids or keyphrase are under now, of each kind the one that lasts longest, and
    /// else the one its address is under (out of races only, `Match::Addr`; but a ban made with an address alone turns
    /// it away).  When one was made with them, what else the hello names is added to it: its other page ids and its
    /// keyphrase for `LINK_MS` (up to `KEYS_MAX` each), the address it came from (its hash) for `ADDR_MS` (up to
    /// `ADDRS_MAX`), or each kept that much longer.  A hello that matches only by what a ban took in later (or by its
    /// address) adds nothing.
    pub fn by_hello(&self, s: &Seen, now: i64) -> Verdict {
        let pages: Vec<String> = s.pages.iter().map(|p| self.page(p)).collect();
        let owners: Vec<String> = s.owner.map(|o| self.owner(o)).into_iter().collect();
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        let (mut v, mut changed) = (Verdict::default(), false);
        for kind in [Kind::Full, Kind::Races] {
            let ban = match longest(&f.bans, |b| b.kind == kind && b.live(now) && b.made_for(&pages, &owners)) {
                Some(i) => {
                    let b = &mut f.bans[i];
                    let (link, addr) = (b.until_for(LINK_MS, now), b.until_for(ADDR_MS, now));
                    for p in pages.iter().filter(|p| !b.pages.contains(p)) {
                        changed |= hold(&mut b.later_pages, p, link, KEYS_MAX, now);
                    }
                    for o in owners.iter().filter(|o| !b.owners.contains(o)) {
                        changed |= hold(&mut b.later_owners, o, link, KEYS_MAX, now);
                    }
                    if let Some(a) = s.addr {
                        changed |= hold(&mut b.addrs, a, addr, ADDRS_MAX, now);
                    }
                    Some(b.clone())
                }
                None => longest(&f.bans, |b| b.kind == kind && b.live(now) && b.took_in(&pages, &owners, now)).map(|i| f.bans[i].clone()),
            };
            match kind {
                Kind::Full => v.full = ban,
                _ => v.races = ban.map(|b| (b, Match::Own)),
            }
        }
        // by its address: a ban made with that alone as by its own keys, any other out of races only
        if let Some(a) = s.addr {
            let at = |b: &Ban, m: Match| b.live(now) && b.at_addr_as(a, now) == Some(m);
            if v.full.is_none() {
                v.full = longest(&f.bans, |b| b.kind == Kind::Full && at(b, Match::Own)).map(|i| f.bans[i].clone());
            }
            if v.races.is_none() {
                v.races = longest(&f.bans, |b| b.kind == Kind::Races && at(b, Match::Own))
                    .map(|i| (f.bans[i].clone(), Match::Own))
                    .or_else(|| longest(&f.bans, |b| at(b, Match::Addr)).map(|i| (f.bans[i].clone(), Match::Addr)));
            }
        }
        if changed {
            self.save_or_say(&mut f, now);
        }
        v
    }

    /// whether `ban` names one of these keys (a connection's: `Bans::keys`) now, and how: the other connections a new
    /// ban removes (`Match::Own`, a full ban) or keeps out of races
    pub fn covers(&self, ban: &Ban, k: &Keys, now: i64) -> Option<Match> {
        if ban.made_for(&k.pages, &k.owners) || ban.took_in(&k.pages, &k.owners, now) {
            return Some(Match::Own);
        }
        let by: Vec<Match> = k.addrs.iter().filter_map(|a| ban.at_addr_as(a, now)).collect();
        by.iter().copied().find(|m| *m == Match::Own).or(by.first().copied())
    }

    /// A new ban of `kind` (full or races) of the player `k` names (`name` for the operator), with `msg`, until
    /// `until` (None: for good).  It takes the place of the bans of its kind that name one of its page ids or
    /// keyphrases (a player without either: one of its addresses); their numbers come back with it.
    pub fn add(&self, kind: Kind, name: &str, k: &Keys, msg: &str, until: Option<i64>, now: i64) -> io::Result<(Ban, Vec<u64>)> {
        if kind == Kind::Name {
            return Err(io::Error::other("a rename is no ban to add (Bans::rename)"));
        }
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        prune(&mut f, now);
        let id = f.next + 1;
        let by_id = !k.pages.is_empty() || !k.owners.is_empty();
        let (same, rest): (Vec<Ban>, Vec<Ban>) = std::mem::take(&mut f.bans).into_iter().partition(|b| {
            b.kind == kind
                && if by_id {
                    b.made_for(&k.pages, &k.owners) || b.took_in(&k.pages, &k.owners, now)
                } else {
                    k.addrs.iter().any(|a| b.addrs.iter().any(|x| &x.h == a))
                }
        });
        f.bans = rest;
        let replaced: Vec<u64> = same.iter().map(|b| b.id).collect();
        f.past.extend(same.into_iter().map(|ban| Past { ban, ended: now, how: How::Replaced, by: Some(id) }));
        f.next = id;
        let b = new_ban(id, kind, name, k, msg, until, now);
        f.bans.push(b.clone());
        note_on_marks(&mut f, k, id, now);
        self.save(&mut f, now)?;
        Ok((b, replaced))
    }

    /// The player `k` names (`player` for the operator) has its `names` taken away from everyone, with `msg`: a
    /// rename in its history, and the names on the names taken away (`deny`: as they read, nfsu2-names `letters`), but
    /// for one with no letters, NAME and Player (the game's names for nobody in particular) and one taken away
    /// already.  The rename comes back with the names it took away.
    pub fn rename(&self, player: &str, names: &[String], k: &Keys, msg: &str, now: i64) -> io::Result<(Ban, Vec<String>)> {
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        prune(&mut f, now);
        f.next += 1;
        let id = f.next;
        let b = new_ban(id, Kind::Name, player, k, msg, Some(now), now);
        f.past.push(Past { ban: b.clone(), ended: now, how: How::Over, by: None });
        let nobody = [nfsu2_names::letters("NAME"), nfsu2_names::letters("Player")];
        let mut took = Vec::new();
        for n in names {
            let l = nfsu2_names::letters(n);
            if l.is_empty() || nobody.contains(&l) || f.names.iter().any(|d| nfsu2_names::letters(&d.name) == l) {
                continue;
            }
            let name: String = clean_msg(n).chars().take(64).collect();
            f.names.push(Denied { name: name.clone(), at: now, by: id });
            took.push(name);
        }
        let over = f.names.len().saturating_sub(NAMES_MAX);
        f.names.drain(..over);
        self.deny.set(f.names.iter().map(|d| d.name.clone()));
        note_on_marks(&mut f, k, id, now);
        self.save(&mut f, now)?;
        Ok((b, took))
    }

    /// the name taken away that `name` reads as, if any
    pub fn denied_as(&self, name: &str) -> Option<Denied> {
        let l = nfsu2_names::letters(name);
        if l.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        self.file.lock().names.iter().find(|d| nfsu2_names::letters(&d.name) == l).cloned()
    }

    /// the names taken away, oldest first
    pub fn denied(&self) -> Vec<Denied> {
        self.file.lock().names.clone()
    }

    /// The names taken away that `name` reads as, given back
    pub fn undeny(&self, name: &str, now: i64) -> io::Result<Vec<Denied>> {
        let l = nfsu2_names::letters(name);
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        let (gone, kept): (Vec<Denied>, Vec<Denied>) = std::mem::take(&mut f.names)
            .into_iter()
            .partition(|d| d.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name.trim()) || (!l.is_empty() && nfsu2_names::letters(&d.name) == l));
        f.names = kept;
        if !gone.is_empty() {
            self.deny.set(f.names.iter().map(|d| d.name.clone()));
            self.save(&mut f, now)?;
        }
        Ok(gone)
    }

    /// The bans `sel` names, lifted (to their players' history): "#4" or "4" (a number), or a name (any case: every
    /// ban of that name).
    pub fn remove(&self, sel: &str, now: i64) -> io::Result<Vec<Ban>> {
        let sel = sel.trim();
        let num = sel.strip_prefix('#').unwrap_or(sel).parse::<u64>().ok();
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        prune(&mut f, now);
        let (gone, kept): (Vec<Ban>, Vec<Ban>) = std::mem::take(&mut f.bans).into_iter().partition(|b| match num {
            Some(n) => b.id == n,
            None => b.name.to_lowercase() == sel.to_lowercase(),
        });
        f.bans = kept;
        if !gone.is_empty() {
            f.past.extend(gone.iter().map(|b| Past { ban: b.clone(), ended: now, how: How::Lifted, by: None }));
            self.save(&mut f, now)?;
        }
        Ok(gone)
    }

    /// The live ban #`id` made another kind (full or races) and/or to last `until` (None: for good): it before and
    /// after.  None: no such ban in force.
    pub fn change(&self, id: u64, kind: Option<Kind>, until: Option<Option<i64>>, now: i64) -> io::Result<Option<(Ban, Ban)>> {
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        prune(&mut f, now);
        let Some(b) = f.bans.iter_mut().find(|b| b.id == id) else { return Ok(None) };
        let before = b.clone();
        if let Some(k) = kind.filter(|&k| k != Kind::Name) {
            b.kind = k;
        }
        if let Some(u) = until {
            b.until = u;
            // what it holds for a time never outlasts it
            if let Some(end) = u {
                for l in [&mut b.addrs, &mut b.later_pages, &mut b.later_owners] {
                    l.iter_mut().for_each(|x| x.until = x.until.min(end));
                }
            }
        }
        let after = b.clone();
        self.save(&mut f, now)?;
        Ok(Some((before, after)))
    }

    /// the live bans, oldest first (the ones whose time is up go)
    pub fn list(&self, now: i64) -> Vec<Ban> {
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        let before = counts(&f);
        prune(&mut f, now);
        if before != counts(&f) {
            self.save_or_say(&mut f, now);
        }
        f.bans.clone()
    }

    /// The ban (in force, or in the history) of that number
    pub fn record(&self, id: u64, now: i64) -> Option<Record> {
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        prune(&mut f, now);
        f.bans
            .iter()
            .find(|b| b.id == id)
            .map(|b| Record { ban: b.clone(), past: None })
            .or_else(|| f.past.iter().find(|p| p.ban.id == id).map(past_record))
    }

    /// The bans of the player `k` names, in force and in the history (renames too), oldest first: each one that
    /// named one of its page ids or keyphrases (for keys without either: one of its addresses), whatever their time
    pub fn history(&self, k: &Keys, now: i64) -> Vec<Record> {
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        prune(&mut f, now);
        let mut v: Vec<Record> = f.past.iter().filter(|p| k.same_player(&p.ban.keys())).map(past_record).collect();
        v.extend(f.bans.iter().filter(|b| k.same_player(&b.keys())).map(|b| Record { ban: b.clone(), past: None }));
        v.sort_by_key(|r| (r.ban.at, r.ban.id));
        v
    }

    /// The bans (in force and in the history) of a player called `name` (any case), oldest first: for one the switch
    /// does not know now
    pub fn history_by_name(&self, name: &str, now: i64) -> Vec<Record> {
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        prune(&mut f, now);
        let is = |b: &Ban| b.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name.trim());
        let mut v: Vec<Record> = f.past.iter().filter(|p| is(&p.ban)).map(past_record).collect();
        v.extend(f.bans.iter().filter(|b| is(b)).map(|b| Record { ban: b.clone(), past: None }));
        v.sort_by_key(|r| (r.ban.at, r.ban.id));
        v
    }

    /// The handle of a `[cheat]` line's player (`k`, `name` for the operator): "c17", which `ban` takes for `MARK_MS`;
    /// with the other names of its earlier lines and the bans made of it since.  The same player again (one of the
    /// same page ids or keyphrases; without either, the same address) keeps its handle, and its time starts again.
    /// The file is written for a new mark, a new name or key of one, or a time SLACK on: many lines of one player at
    /// once (a race's, a cheat's every race) write it once.
    pub fn mark(&self, name: &str, k: Keys, now: i64) -> io::Result<Marked> {
        let mut f = self.file.lock();
        let (m, changed) = match f.marks.iter_mut().find(|m| m.at + MARK_MS > now && k.same_player(&m.keys)) {
            Some(m) => {
                let count = |k: &Keys| k.addrs.len() + k.pages.len() + k.owners.len();
                let keys = count(&m.keys);
                m.keys.extend(k);
                let changed = m.name != name || now - m.at >= SLACK || count(&m.keys) != keys;
                if m.name != name {
                    let was = std::mem::replace(&mut m.name, name.to_string());
                    let same = |a: &str, b: &str| a.to_lowercase() == b.to_lowercase();
                    m.before.retain(|x| !same(x, name) && !same(x, &was));
                    if !same(&was, name) {
                        m.before.push(was);
                    }
                    if m.before.len() > MARK_NAMES_MAX {
                        m.before.remove(0);
                    }
                }
                m.at = now;
                (m.clone(), changed)
            }
            None => {
                f.next_mark += 1;
                let mut keys = Keys::default();
                keys.extend(k);
                let m = Mark { n: f.next_mark, name: name.to_string(), at: now, keys, before: vec![], bans: vec![] };
                f.marks.push(m.clone());
                if f.marks.len() > MARKS_MAX {
                    f.marks.remove(0);
                }
                (m, true)
            }
        };
        let of = |id: u64| {
            let b = f.bans.iter().find(|b| b.id == id).or_else(|| f.past.iter().map(|p| &p.ban).find(|b| b.id == id));
            b.map_or((id, false, Kind::Full), |b| (id, b.live(now), b.kind))
        };
        let bans = m.bans.iter().map(|&id| of(id)).collect();
        if changed {
            self.save(&mut f, now)?;
        }
        Ok(Marked { handle: m.handle(), before: m.before, bans })
    }

    /// the live mark of a handle ("c17", any case)
    pub fn marked(&self, handle: &str, now: i64) -> Option<Mark> {
        let n = handle.trim().strip_prefix(['c', 'C'])?.parse::<u64>().ok()?;
        self.file.lock().marks.iter().find(|m| m.n == n && m.at + MARK_MS > now).cloned()
    }

    fn save_or_say(&self, f: &mut File, now: i64) {
        if let Err(e) = self.save(f, now) {
            nfsu2_util::log::error(&format!("{}: {e}", self.path.display()));
        }
    }

    /// the file written whole, without what is over
    fn save(&self, f: &mut File, now: i64) -> io::Result<()> {
        prune(f, now);
        let mut text = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&*f).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
        text.push('\n');
        nfsu2_util::atomic_file::write(&self.path, text.as_bytes())
    }
}

/// a ban as `add` and `rename` make it: the keys it was made with, its addresses for `ADDR_MS`
fn new_ban(id: u64, kind: Kind, name: &str, k: &Keys, msg: &str, until: Option<i64>, now: i64) -> Ban {
    let mut b = Ban {
        id,
        kind,
        name: name.to_string(),
        msg: clean_msg(msg),
        at: now,
        until,
        pages: vec![],
        owners: vec![],
        later_pages: vec![],
        later_owners: vec![],
        addrs: vec![],
    };
    let mut own = Keys::default();
    own.extend(k.clone());
    let addr = if kind == Kind::Name { now } else { b.until_for(ADDR_MS, now) };
    // the latest (a mark's and a player's keys name the newest last)
    let skip = own.addrs.len().saturating_sub(ADDRS_MAX);
    b.addrs = own.addrs.into_iter().skip(skip).map(|h| Held { h, until: addr }).collect();
    (b.pages, b.owners) = (own.pages, own.owners);
    b
}

/// the marks of the player `k` names (a ban by its handle, or of one with a mark by its name or address) have ban `id`
fn note_on_marks(f: &mut File, k: &Keys, id: u64, now: i64) {
    for m in f.marks.iter_mut().filter(|m| m.at + MARK_MS > now && k.same_player(&m.keys)) {
        m.bans.push(id);
        if m.bans.len() > MARK_NAMES_MAX {
            m.bans.remove(0);
        }
    }
}

fn past_record(p: &Past) -> Record {
    Record { ban: p.ban.clone(), past: Some((p.ended, p.how, p.by)) }
}

/// `h` held until `until` in `l` (at most `max` long; one whose time is up makes room): false when that changed
/// nothing worth writing
fn hold(l: &mut Vec<Held>, h: &str, until: i64, max: usize, now: i64) -> bool {
    if let Some(x) = l.iter_mut().find(|x| x.h == h) {
        let later = x.until < until - SLACK;
        if later {
            x.until = until;
        }
        return later;
    }
    if l.len() >= max {
        let Some(old) = l.iter().position(|x| x.until <= now) else { return false };
        l.remove(old);
    }
    l.push(Held { h: h.to_string(), until });
    true
}

/// a ban's addresses cut to the `ADDRS_MAX` held longest (the ones last seen)
fn latest_addrs(l: &mut Vec<Held>) {
    if l.len() > ADDRS_MAX {
        l.sort_by_key(|h| std::cmp::Reverse(h.until));
        l.truncate(ADDRS_MAX);
    }
}

/// the bans whose time is up go to the history, what the others name for a time goes when its time is up, and so do
/// the history's bans a year after they ended and the marks whose time is up
fn prune(f: &mut File, now: i64) {
    let (live, over): (Vec<Ban>, Vec<Ban>) = std::mem::take(&mut f.bans).into_iter().partition(|b| b.live(now));
    f.bans = live;
    f.past.extend(over.into_iter().map(|ban| Past { ended: ban.until.unwrap_or(now), how: How::Over, by: None, ban }));
    for b in &mut f.bans {
        for l in [&mut b.addrs, &mut b.later_pages, &mut b.later_owners] {
            l.retain(|x| x.until > now);
        }
    }
    f.past.retain(|p| p.ended + PAST_MS > now);
    let over = f.past.len().saturating_sub(PAST_MAX);
    f.past.drain(..over);
    f.marks.retain(|m| m.at + MARK_MS > now);
}

/// how much the file holds: what `list` compares to see whether `prune` took anything
fn counts(f: &File) -> (usize, usize, usize, usize) {
    let held = f.bans.iter().map(|b| b.addrs.len() + b.later_pages.len() + b.later_owners.len()).sum();
    (f.bans.len(), held, f.marks.len(), f.past.len())
}

/// of the bans `f` takes, the index of the one that lasts longest (for good first)
fn longest(bans: &[Ban], f: impl Fn(&Ban) -> bool) -> Option<usize> {
    bans.iter().enumerate().filter(|(_, b)| f(b)).max_by_key(|(_, b)| b.until.unwrap_or(i64::MAX)).map(|(i, _)| i)
}

/// the key (32 random bytes), made 0600 at the first start
fn load_key(p: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    if let Ok(mut file) = std::fs::File::open(p) {
        let mut k = Vec::new();
        if file.read_to_end(&mut k).is_ok() && k.len() >= 32 {
            return Ok(k);
        }
    }
    let k = nfsu2_util::rand::bytes(32);
    let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).create(true).truncate(true).mode(0o600).open(p)?;
    file.write_all(&k)?;
    Ok(k)
}

/// a message as the page shows it: one line, no control or direction characters, at most `MSG_MAX` characters
pub fn clean_msg(s: &str) -> String {
    let bidi = |c: char| matches!(c, '\u{200B}'..='\u{200F}' | '\u{202A}'..='\u{202E}' | '\u{2060}'..='\u{2069}' | '\u{FEFF}');
    let t: String = s.chars().map(|c| if c.is_whitespace() { ' ' } else { c }).filter(|&c| !c.is_control() && !bidi(c)).collect();
    t.split(' ').filter(|w| !w.is_empty()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ").chars().take(MSG_MAX).collect()
}

/// How long a ban lasts, as the operator writes it: "30m", "12h", "3d", "2w" (a whole number and its unit; "min" for
/// m too), or "perm" (for good: None).  Not one of those (or over `FOR_MAX`): Err.
pub fn parse_for(s: &str) -> Result<Option<i64>, String> {
    let s = s.trim().to_lowercase();
    if matches!(s.as_str(), "perm" | "permanent" | "forever") {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    let at = s.find(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(s.len());
    let (n, unit) = s.split_at(at);
    let unit_ms = match unit {
        "m" | "min" => MIN,
        "h" => HOUR,
        "d" => DAY,
        "w" => 7 * DAY,
        _ => return Err(format!("\"{s}\": how long, as 30m, 12h, 3d, 2w or perm")),
    };
    match n.parse::<i64>() {
        Ok(n) if n > 0 && n.checked_mul(unit_ms).is_some_and(|ms| ms <= FOR_MAX) => Ok(Some(n * unit_ms)),
        _ => Err(format!("\"{s}\": how long, as 30m, 12h, 3d, 2w or perm (at most ten years)")),
    }
}

/// a span of time, for the operator: "45 min", "5 h 10 min", "2 d 23 h"
pub fn span(ms: i64) -> String {
    let m = (ms.max(0) + MIN - 1) / MIN;
    let (d, h, mi) = (m / (24 * 60), m / 60 % 24, m % 60);
    match (d, h, mi) {
        (0, 0, mi) => format!("{mi} min"),
        (0, h, 0) => format!("{h} h"),
        (0, h, mi) => format!("{h} h {mi} min"),
        (d, 0, _) => format!("{d} d"),
        (d, h, _) => format!("{d} d {h} h"),
    }
}

/// a time, for the operator: "2026-10-27 14:05 UTC"
pub fn when(ms: i64) -> String {
    let (y, mo, d, h, mi, _, _) = nfsu2_util::js::utc_parts(ms);
    format!("{y:04}-{mo:02}-{d:02} {h:02}:{mi:02} UTC")
}

use super::*;

const T0: i64 = 1_790_000_000_000;

fn bans() -> (tempfile::TempDir, Bans) {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let b = Bans::open(dir.path()).unwrap();
    (dir, b)
}

/// a player's keys: its address's hash, its page id, its keyphrase's owner
fn who(b: &Bans, addr: Option<&str>, page: Option<&str>, owner: Option<&str>) -> Keys {
    b.keys(addr, page, owner)
}

/// a hello: its page ids, its keyphrase's owner, its address's hash
fn hello(b: &Bans, pages: &[&str], owner: Option<&str>, addr: Option<&str>, now: i64) -> Option<Ban> {
    b.by_hello(&Seen { pages, owner, addr }, now).full
}

/// what a stranger's hello from this address (its hash) hears: a ban's number and how the ban names it (never a full
/// ban: `hello` says so)
fn stranger(b: &Bans, addr: &str, now: i64) -> Option<(u64, Match)> {
    let v = b.by_hello(&Seen { pages: &["a-stranger"], owner: Some("a-stranger's-key"), addr: Some(addr) }, now);
    v.races.map(|(x, m)| (x.id, m))
}

#[test]
fn a_ban_turns_away_its_page_and_keeps_its_address_out_of_races() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let (a1, a2) = (b.addr("203.0.113.5"), b.addr("198.51.100.7"));
    assert_ne!(a1, a2);
    assert_eq!(a1.len(), 22);
    let (ban, replaced) =
        b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&a1), Some("page-1"), None), " Ramming,\n3 days ", Some(T0 + 3 * DAY), T0).unwrap();
    assert!(replaced.is_empty());
    assert_eq!((ban.id, ban.msg.as_str()), (1, "Ramming, 3 days"));
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &a1, T0 + 1), Some((1, Match::Addr)));
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["page-2"], None, Some(&a1), T0 + 1), None, "a stranger at its address plays on");
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &a2, T0 + 1), None);
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["page-2"], None, Some(&a2), T0 + 1), None);
    // the banned page at another address: that address is the ban's too
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["page-1"], None, Some(&a2), T0 + 1).map(|x| x.id), Some(1));
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &a2, T0 + 2), Some((1, Match::Addr)));
    // and its time is up with the ban's
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &a1, T0 + 3 * DAY), None);
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["page-1"], None, None, T0 + 3 * DAY), None);
    assert!(b.list(T0 + 3 * DAY).is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn an_address_is_kept_out_of_races_for_a_week_after_it_was_last_the_players_and_never_bans_a_page() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let a = b.addr("203.0.113.5");
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&a), Some("p"), None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    // whoever else comes from that address races nobody, but their page and keyphrase are not banned for it
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a, T0 + DAY).is_some());
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["someone-else"], Some("their-keyphrase"), Some(&a), T0 + DAY), None);
    let ban = &b.list(T0 + DAY)[0];
    assert_eq!((ban.pages.len(), ban.later_pages.len(), ban.later_owners.len()), (1, 0, 0));
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a, T0 + ADDR_MS).is_none(), "the address goes after a week");
    // the page comes back from it after two weeks: a week more for the address
    assert!(hello(&b, &["p"], None, Some(&a), T0 + 14 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a, T0 + 20 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a, T0 + 21 * DAY).is_none());
    // for good: the page still
    assert!(hello(&b, &["p"], None, None, T0 + 3000 * DAY).is_some());
    assert_eq!(b.list(T0 + 3000 * DAY)[0].addrs, vec![]);
}

#[test]
fn a_banned_keyphrase_brings_in_a_new_browser_for_a_month_and_that_spreads_no_further() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let (home, phone, cafe) = (b.addr("203.0.113.5"), b.addr("198.51.100.7"), b.addr("192.0.2.1"));
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&home), Some("pc"), Some("bob-key")), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    // the keyphrase in a new browser on another network: turned away, and that browser and network are taken in
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["phone"], Some("bob-key"), Some(&phone), T0 + 1).map(|x| x.id), Some(1));
    let ban = &b.list(T0 + 2)[0];
    assert_eq!((ban.pages.len(), ban.later_pages.len(), ban.owners.len(), ban.addrs.len()), (1, 1, 1, 2));
    assert!(stranger(&b, &phone, T0 + 2).is_some());
    // that browser alone, without the keyphrase: turned away, but it brings in nothing (a friend's browser, say:
    // not its network, not its owner's own keyphrase)
    assert!(hello(&b, &["phone"], Some("friend-key"), Some(&cafe), T0 + 3).is_some());
    assert!(stranger(&b, &cafe, T0 + 4).is_none());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["friend-pc"], Some("friend-key"), None, T0 + 4).is_none());
    // for a month after it was last seen with the keyphrase (seen alone, it is not kept longer)
    assert!(hello(&b, &["phone"], None, None, T0 + LINK_MS).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["phone"], None, None, T0 + 1 + LINK_MS).is_none());
    // seen with it again: another month
    assert!(hello(&b, &["phone"], Some("bob-key"), None, T0 + 40 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["phone"], None, None, T0 + 69 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["phone"], None, None, T0 + 70 * DAY + 1).is_none());
    assert_eq!(b.list(T0 + 71 * DAY)[0].later_pages, vec![], "gone from the file");
    // a banned page with a new keyphrase: that keyphrase for a month, but not a browser it is used in then
    assert!(hello(&b, &["pc"], Some("bob-new-key"), None, T0 + 80 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["fresh"], Some("bob-new-key"), None, T0 + 81 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["fresh"], None, None, T0 + 82 * DAY).is_none());
    // a page that found the banned id beside its new one: the new one for a month
    assert!(hello(&b, &["cleared", "pc"], None, None, T0 + 90 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["cleared"], None, None, T0 + 91 * DAY).is_some());
    let ban = &b.list(T0 + 92 * DAY)[0];
    assert_eq!((ban.later_pages.len(), ban.later_owners.len()), (1, 1));
    // what the ban was made with lasts as long as it does
    assert!(hello(&b, &["pc"], None, None, T0 + 3000 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["x"], Some("bob-key"), None, T0 + 3000 * DAY).is_some());
    // a ban for a week: what it takes in goes with it
    let (_d2, b) = bans();
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Eve", &who(&b, None, Some("e"), Some("eve-key")), "", Some(T0 + 7 * DAY), T0).unwrap();
    assert!(hello(&b, &["e2"], Some("eve-key"), None, T0 + 1).is_some());
    assert_eq!(b.list(T0 + 2)[0].later_pages[0].until, T0 + 7 * DAY);
    // the file names nothing as it came
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&b.path).unwrap();
    assert!(!text.contains("eve-key") && !text.contains("\"e2\""), "{text}");
}

#[test]
fn a_ban_takes_in_at_most_keys_max_pages_and_keyphrases_and_keeps_the_first() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, None, Some("p0"), Some("k0")), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    for i in 1..100 {
        let (p, k) = (format!("p{i}"), format!("k{i}"));
        assert!(hello(&b, &[&p], Some("k0"), None, T0 + i).is_some(), "{p} with the banned keyphrase");
        assert!(hello(&b, &["p0"], Some(&k), None, T0 + i).is_some(), "{k} in the banned page");
    }
    let ban = &b.list(T0 + 100)[0];
    assert_eq!((ban.later_pages.len(), ban.later_owners.len()), (KEYS_MAX, KEYS_MAX));
    assert!(hello(&b, &["p1"], None, None, T0 + 101).is_some() && hello(&b, &["p32"], None, None, T0 + 101).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["p33"], None, None, T0 + 101).is_none(), "past the cap: turned away that time, not kept");
    assert!(hello(&b, &["x"], Some("k32"), None, T0 + 101).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["x"], Some("k33"), None, T0 + 101).is_none());
}

#[test]
fn a_new_ban_of_the_same_page_or_keyphrase_takes_the_place_of_the_old_one() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let a = b.addr("203.0.113.5");
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&a), Some("p"), None), "a day", Some(T0 + DAY), T0).unwrap();
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Eve", &who(&b, Some(&a), Some("q"), None), "eve", Some(T0 + DAY), T0).unwrap();
    let (ban, replaced) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&a), Some("p"), None), "for good", None, T0 + 1).unwrap();
    assert_eq!((ban.id, replaced), (3, vec![1]));
    let names: Vec<_> = b.list(T0 + 2).iter().map(|x| (x.id, x.name.clone())).collect();
    assert_eq!(names, vec![(2, "Eve".to_string()), (3, "Bob".to_string())]);
    // a player without a page id: by address
    let c = b.addr("192.0.2.1");
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Old", &who(&b, Some(&c), None, None), "", Some(T0 + DAY), T0).unwrap();
    let (_, replaced) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Old", &who(&b, Some(&c), None, None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(replaced, vec![4]);
    // the longest of two that match is the one a page is told
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &a, T0 + 2).map(|(id, _)| id), Some(3));
    // the same keyphrase in another browser
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Kim", &who(&b, None, Some("k1"), Some("kim-key")), "", Some(T0 + DAY), T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b.add(Kind::Full, "Kim", &who(&b, None, Some("k2"), Some("kim-key")), "", None, T0 + 1).unwrap().1, vec![6]);
    // a player in two browsers at once (its keys together): both, each once
    let mut two = who(&b, Some(&c), Some("t1"), Some("two-key"));
    two.extend(who(&b, Some(&c), Some("t2"), Some("two-key")));
    let (ban, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Two", &two, "", None, T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!((ban.pages.len(), ban.owners.len(), ban.addrs.len()), (2, 1, 1));
}

#[test]
fn bans_are_lifted_by_number_or_name() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let a = b.addr("203.0.113.5");
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&a), Some("p"), None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    b.add(Kind::Full, "bob", &who(&b, None, Some("q"), None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Eve", &who(&b, None, Some("r"), None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b.remove("#3", T0).unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(b.remove("BOB", T0).unwrap().iter().map(|x| x.id).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![1, 2]);
    assert!(b.remove("4", T0).unwrap().is_empty());
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a, T0).is_none());
}

#[test]
fn a_cheat_lines_player_is_marked_for_a_week_by_one_handle() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let a = b.addr("203.0.113.5");
    assert_eq!(b.mark("Bob", who(&b, Some(&a), Some("bob-page"), Some("bob-key")), T0).unwrap().handle, "c1");
    assert_eq!(b.mark("Eve", who(&b, None, Some("eve-page"), None), T0 + 1).unwrap().handle, "c2");
    // Bob again, in another browser with his keyphrase, and at another address: the same handle, from then
    let a2 = b.addr("198.51.100.7");
    assert_eq!(b.mark("Bobby", who(&b, Some(&a2), Some("bob-phone"), Some("bob-key")), T0 + DAY).unwrap().handle, "c1");
    let m = b.marked("C1", T0 + DAY).expect("Bob's mark");
    assert_eq!((m.name.as_str(), m.keys.addrs.len(), m.keys.pages.len(), m.keys.owners.len()), ("Bobby", 2, 2, 1));
    assert!(b.marked("c3", T0).is_none() && b.marked("x1", T0).is_none() && b.marked("c", T0).is_none());
    // a week after its last line
    assert!(b.marked("c1", T0 + DAY + MARK_MS - 1).is_some());
    assert!(b.marked("c1", T0 + DAY + MARK_MS).is_none());
    assert!(b.marked("c2", T0 + 1 + MARK_MS).is_none());
    // a ban by its keys: whoever has one of them
    let (ban, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, &m.name, &m.keys, "", None, T0 + DAY).unwrap();
    assert!(hello(&b, &["bob-phone"], None, None, T0 + DAY).is_some());
    assert_eq!(b.covers(&ban, &who(&b, None, Some("new"), Some("bob-key")), T0 + DAY), Some(Match::Own));
    assert_eq!(b.covers(&ban, &who(&b, Some(&a2), Some("new"), None), T0 + DAY), Some(Match::Addr));
    assert_eq!(b.covers(&ban, &who(&b, None, Some("new"), None), T0 + DAY), None);
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a2, T0 + DAY).is_some());
    // the file: hashes only, and the marks outlive a restart; a new handle after the old ones
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&b.path).unwrap();
    assert!(!text.contains("bob-") && !text.contains("203.0.113"), "{text}");
    // (Bob's next lines at once, nothing new of him: the file is not written again)
    std::fs::write(&b.path, "kept").unwrap();
    for i in 1..=50 {
        assert_eq!(b.mark("Bobby", who(&b, Some(&a2), Some("bob-phone"), Some("bob-key")), T0 + DAY + i).unwrap().handle, "c1");
    }
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(&b.path).unwrap(), "kept");
    std::fs::write(&b.path, text).unwrap();
    let b = Bans::open(b.path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b.marked("c1", T0 + DAY).map(|m| m.name), Some("Bobby".into()));
    assert_eq!(b.mark("Kim", who(&b, None, Some("kim"), None), T0 + DAY).unwrap().handle, "c3");
    // their time up: gone from the file
    b.list(T0 + DAY + MARK_MS);
    let file: Value = serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(&b.path).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(file["marks"].as_array().map(Vec::len), Some(0), "{file}");
}

// a marked player back under other names (one ban of it ended, one in force): its earlier lines' names, each
// once, and its bans, by the handle or by name
#[test]
fn a_mark_says_the_players_earlier_names_and_its_bans() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let k = || who(&b, None, Some("rex-page"), None);
    assert_eq!(b.mark("Rex", k(), T0).unwrap(), Marked { handle: "c1".into(), before: vec![], bans: vec![] });
    let keys = b.marked("c1", T0).unwrap().keys;
    let (one, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Rex", &keys, "", Some(T0 + DAY), T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b.mark("Rex", k(), T0 + 1).unwrap().bans, [(one.id, true, Kind::Full)]);
    let m = b.mark("Turbo", k(), T0 + 2 * DAY).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(m, Marked { handle: "c1".into(), before: vec!["Rex".into()], bans: vec![(one.id, false, Kind::Full)] });
    assert_eq!(b.mark("Zoomer", k(), T0 + 2 * DAY + 1).unwrap().before, ["Rex", "Turbo"]);
    assert_eq!(b.mark("rex", k(), T0 + 2 * DAY + 2).unwrap().before, ["Turbo", "Zoomer"]);
    // banned by its name (not the handle): the mark has that ban too
    let (two, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "rex", &k(), "", None, T0 + 3 * DAY).unwrap();
    let m = b.mark("rex", k(), T0 + 3 * DAY).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(m.bans, [(one.id, false, Kind::Full), (two.id, true, Kind::Full)]);
    // kept over a restart
    let b = Bans::open(b.path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let m = b.marked("c1", T0 + 3 * DAY).unwrap();
    assert_eq!((m.before.len(), m.bans), (2, vec![one.id, two.id]));
}

#[test]
fn the_file_keeps_hashes_only_and_outlives_a_restart() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let b = Bans::open(dir.path()).unwrap();
    let a = b.addr("203.0.113.5");
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&a), Some("page-secret"), Some("owner-secret")), "msg", Some(T0 + DAY), T0).unwrap();
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join("bans.json")).unwrap();
    assert!(!text.contains("203.0.113") && !text.contains("page-secret") && !text.contains("owner-secret"), "{text}");
    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
    for f in ["bans.json", "bans.key"] {
        assert_eq!(std::fs::metadata(dir.path().join(f)).unwrap().permissions().mode() & 0o777, 0o600, "{f}");
    }
    drop(b);
    let b = Bans::open(dir.path()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b.addr("203.0.113.5"), a, "the same key");
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["page-secret"], None, None, T0 + 1).map(|x| x.msg), Some("msg".into()));
    assert!(hello(&b, &["elsewhere"], Some("owner-secret"), None, T0 + 1).is_some());
    let (next, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Eve", &who(&b, None, Some("x"), None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(next.id, 2);
    // a file from before keyphrases and marks
    let old = r#"{"next":1,"bans":[{"id":1,"name":"Old","at":0,"until":null,"pages":["x"],"addrs":[{"h":"y","until":9}]}]}"#;
    std::fs::write(dir.path().join("bans.json"), old).unwrap();
    let ban = Bans::open(dir.path()).unwrap().list(0)[0].clone();
    assert_eq!((ban.owners.len(), ban.later_pages.len(), ban.addrs[0].until), (0, 0, 9));
    // a broken file: not taken for no bans
    std::fs::write(dir.path().join("bans.json"), "{").unwrap();
    assert!(Bans::open(dir.path()).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn messages_for_the_page() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let (ban, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "B", &who(&b, None, Some("p"), None), "Bye \"now\"", Some(T0 + DAY), T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(ban.message(Match::Own), format!(r#"{{"t":"ban","id":1,"name":"B","at":{T0},"msg":"Bye \"now\"","until":{}}}"#, T0 + DAY));
    // by the address only: out of races, and the page says why
    assert_eq!(
        ban.message(Match::Addr),
        format!(r#"{{"t":"races","id":1,"name":"B","at":{T0},"msg":"Bye \"now\"","until":{},"addr":true}}"#, T0 + DAY)
    );
    let (ban, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "B\u{202E}ob", &who(&b, None, Some("p"), None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(ban.message(Match::Own), format!(r#"{{"t":"ban","id":2,"name":"Bob","at":{T0},"msg":""}}"#));
    assert_eq!(kick_message("a\u{202E}b\tc"), r#"{"t":"kick","msg":"ab c"}"#);
    assert_eq!(clean_msg(&"x".repeat(300)).len(), MSG_MAX);
}

#[test]
fn how_long_as_the_operator_writes_it() {
    assert_eq!(parse_for("30m"), Ok(Some(30 * MIN)));
    assert_eq!(parse_for("30min"), Ok(Some(30 * MIN)));
    assert_eq!(parse_for("12h"), Ok(Some(12 * HOUR)));
    assert_eq!(parse_for("3D"), Ok(Some(3 * DAY)));
    assert_eq!(parse_for("2w"), Ok(Some(14 * DAY)));
    assert_eq!(parse_for("perm"), Ok(None));
    assert_eq!(parse_for("forever"), Ok(None));
    for bad in ["", "3", "d", "0d", "-1d", "1.5d", "3 days", "99999999999999w", "3651d"] {
        assert!(parse_for(bad).is_err(), "{bad}");
    }
    assert_eq!(span(45 * MIN), "45 min");
    assert_eq!(span(5 * HOUR + 10 * MIN), "5 h 10 min");
    assert_eq!(span(3 * DAY - 1), "3 d");
    assert_eq!(span(2 * DAY + 23 * HOUR), "2 d 23 h");
    assert_eq!(span(12 * HOUR), "12 h");
    assert_eq!(when(1_793_109_900_000), "2026-10-27 14:05 UTC");
}

/// a hello's race ban (by its own keys or its address)
fn races(b: &Bans, pages: &[&str], owner: Option<&str>, addr: Option<&str>, now: i64) -> Option<Ban> {
    b.by_hello(&Seen { pages, owner, addr }, now).races.map(|(x, _)| x)
}

// a race ban turns nobody away: the hello hears it as the race ban, by the page, the keyphrase and (unlike a full
// ban's hello) the address; it takes in a new browser the way a full ban does
#[test]
fn a_race_ban_keeps_its_player_out_of_races_only() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let (home, phone) = (b.addr("203.0.113.5"), b.addr("198.51.100.7"));
    let (ban, _) =
        b.add(Kind::Races, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&home), Some("pc"), Some("bob-key")), "Cheating", Some(T0 + 14 * DAY), T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(ban.kind, Kind::Races);
    assert_eq!(
        ban.message(Match::Own),
        format!(r#"{{"t":"races","id":1,"name":"Bob","at":{T0},"msg":"Cheating","until":{}}}"#, T0 + 14 * DAY)
    );
    assert!(hello(&b, &["other"], None, Some(&home), T0 + 1).is_none(), "no connection turned away");
    assert!(hello(&b, &["pc"], None, None, T0 + 1).is_none());
    assert_eq!(races(&b, &["pc"], None, None, T0 + 1).map(|x| x.id), Some(ban.id));
    assert_eq!(races(&b, &["new"], Some("bob-key"), Some(&phone), T0 + 1).map(|x| x.id), Some(ban.id));
    // that browser and network were taken in
    assert!(races(&b, &["new"], None, None, T0 + 2).is_some());
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &phone, T0 + 2), Some((ban.id, Match::Addr)), "its address, at the hello");
    assert!(races(&b, &["other"], None, Some(&b.addr("192.0.2.1")), T0 + 2).is_none());
    // a full ban of the same player stands beside it, and goes first
    let (full, replaced) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, None, Some("pc"), None), "", Some(T0 + DAY), T0 + 3).unwrap();
    assert!(replaced.is_empty(), "another kind: not replaced");
    let v = b.by_hello(&Seen { pages: &["pc"], owner: None, addr: None }, T0 + 4);
    assert_eq!((v.full.map(|x| x.id), v.races.map(|(x, m)| (x.id, m))), (Some(full.id), Some((ban.id, Match::Own))));
    let v = b.by_hello(&Seen { pages: &["pc"], owner: None, addr: None }, T0 + 2 * DAY);
    assert_eq!((v.full, v.races.map(|(x, m)| (x.id, m))), (None, Some((ban.id, Match::Own))));
    // a new race ban takes the old one's place
    let (again, replaced) = b.add(Kind::Races, "Bob", &who(&b, None, Some("pc"), None), "", None, T0 + 3 * DAY).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(replaced, vec![ban.id]);
    assert_eq!(races(&b, &["pc"], None, None, T0 + 400 * DAY).map(|x| x.id), Some(again.id));
}

// what a player had stays a year after it ended: bans whose time was up, lifted, replaced, renames; by the player's
// page or keyphrase, or by the name it was banned under
#[test]
fn a_players_history_keeps_its_bans_for_a_year() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let bob = || who(&b, Some(&b.addr("203.0.113.5")), Some("pc"), Some("bob-key"));
    let (one, _) = b.add(Kind::Races, "Bob", &bob(), "first", Some(T0 + 14 * DAY), T0).unwrap();
    let (two, _) = b.add(Kind::Races, "Bob", &bob(), "second", None, T0 + 30 * DAY).unwrap();
    let (three, _) = b.rename("Bob", &["Bob".into()], &bob(), "", T0 + 31 * DAY).unwrap();
    let (four, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &bob(), "", Some(T0 + 40 * DAY), T0 + 32 * DAY).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b.remove(&format!("#{}", four.id), T0 + 33 * DAY).unwrap().len(), 1);
    b.add(Kind::Full, "Eve", &who(&b, None, Some("eve"), None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    // in another browser, with the keyphrase
    let h = b.history(&who(&b, None, Some("phone"), Some("bob-key")), T0 + 34 * DAY);
    let got: Vec<_> = h.iter().map(|r| (r.ban.id, r.ban.kind, r.past)).collect();
    assert_eq!(
        got,
        vec![
            (one.id, Kind::Races, Some((T0 + 14 * DAY, How::Over, None))),
            (two.id, Kind::Races, None),
            (three.id, Kind::Name, Some((T0 + 31 * DAY, How::Over, None))),
            (four.id, Kind::Full, Some((T0 + 33 * DAY, How::Lifted, None))),
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(b.history_by_name("BOB", T0 + 34 * DAY).len(), 4);
    assert_eq!(b.record(one.id, T0 + 34 * DAY).map(|r| r.ban.msg), Some("first".into()));
    // replaced: by the new one
    let (five, _) = b.add(Kind::Races, "Bob", &bob(), "", Some(T0 + 60 * DAY), T0 + 35 * DAY).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b.record(two.id, T0 + 35 * DAY).and_then(|r| r.past), Some((T0 + 35 * DAY, How::Replaced, Some(five.id))));
    // a restart keeps it, and the file names nobody as it came
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&b.path).unwrap();
    assert!(!text.contains("bob-key") && !text.contains("\"pc\"") && !text.contains("203.0.113"), "{text}");
    let b2 = Bans::open(b.path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(b2.history(&bob(), T0 + 36 * DAY).len(), 5);
    // a year after each ended: gone, the rest stays
    let ids = |now| b.history(&bob(), now).iter().map(|r| r.ban.id).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assert_eq!(ids(T0 + 14 * DAY + PAST_MS), vec![two.id, three.id, four.id, five.id]);
    assert_eq!(ids(T0 + 60 * DAY + PAST_MS), Vec::<u64>::new());
}

// a rename takes the names away from everyone, as they read; NAME and Player never; unname gives one back
#[test]
fn a_rename_takes_the_name_away_from_everyone() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let deny = b.deny();
    let k = who(&b, None, Some("p"), None);
    let names: Vec<String> = ["B4d_N4me", "Player", "NAME", "1234", "badname"].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    let (r, took) = b.rename("B4d_N4me", &names, &k, "Not that one", T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!((r.kind, r.live(T0), took), (Kind::Name, false, vec!["B4d_N4me".to_string()]));
    assert!(b.list(T0).is_empty(), "a rename is no ban in force");
    for n in ["BadName", "bad name", "B4dN4me2000"] {
        assert!(deny.has(n), "{n}");
        assert_eq!(b.denied_as(n).map(|d| d.by), Some(r.id), "{n}");
    }
    assert!(!deny.has("Player") && !deny.has("GoodName") && b.denied_as("GoodName").is_none());
    // the same name again: nothing new
    assert!(b.rename("Bad Name", &["Bad Name".into()], &k, "", T0 + 1).unwrap().1.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(b.denied().len(), 1);
    // kept over a restart
    let b2 = Bans::open(b.path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert!(b2.deny().has("badname"));
    // given back
    assert_eq!(b2.undeny("BADNAME", T0 + 2).unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert!(!b2.deny().has("B4d_N4me") && b2.denied().is_empty());
    assert!(b2.undeny("BadName", T0 + 3).unwrap().is_empty());
    // a rename is in the player's history
    assert_eq!(b2.history(&k, T0 + 4).iter().map(|r| r.ban.kind).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![Kind::Name, Kind::Name]);
}

// a ban changed: its kind, or how long it lasts from now on; what it holds for a time never outlasts it
#[test]
fn a_ban_changed_keeps_its_number_and_its_keys() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let a = b.addr("203.0.113.5");
    let (ban, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Bob", &who(&b, Some(&a), Some("p"), None), "msg", None, T0).unwrap();
    let (before, after) = b.change(ban.id, Some(Kind::Races), None, T0 + 1).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!((before.kind, after.kind, after.until, after.id), (Kind::Full, Kind::Races, None, ban.id));
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &a, T0 + 2), Some((ban.id, Match::Addr)));
    assert!(races(&b, &["p"], None, None, T0 + 2).is_some() && hello(&b, &["p"], None, None, T0 + 2).is_none());
    let (_, after) = b.change(ban.id, None, Some(Some(T0 + DAY)), T0 + 3).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!((after.kind, after.until, after.addrs[0].until), (Kind::Races, Some(T0 + DAY), T0 + DAY));
    assert!(races(&b, &["p"], None, None, T0 + DAY).is_none(), "its time is up");
    assert_eq!(b.change(ban.id, Some(Kind::Full), None, T0 + DAY).unwrap(), None, "no longer in force");
    assert_eq!(b.change(99, Some(Kind::Full), None, T0).unwrap(), None);
    assert!(b.add(Kind::Name, "x", &who(&b, None, Some("q"), None), "", None, T0).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn messages_for_a_rename_and_a_race_ban_lifted() {
    assert_eq!(rename_message("Bad\u{202E}Name", " Pick\nanother "), r#"{"t":"rename","name":"BadName","msg":"Pick another"}"#);
    assert_eq!(races_lifted_message(), r#"{"t":"races","lifted":true}"#);
}

// an address alone never turns anyone away: a VPN's server or a phone network is many players' at once.  Whoever comes
// from a banned player's address races nobody (its page hears why); its own race ban goes first.  A ban made with an
// address alone (a tool without a page id) is its own key: that one is turned away.
#[test]
fn an_address_alone_keeps_out_of_races_only() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let (vpn, home) = (b.addr("203.0.113.5"), b.addr("198.51.100.7"));
    let (full, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Cheat", &who(&b, Some(&vpn), Some("cheat-pc"), Some("cheat-key")), "Cheating", None, T0).unwrap();
    let v = b.by_hello(&Seen { pages: &["someone"], owner: Some("their-key"), addr: Some(&vpn) }, T0 + 1);
    assert_eq!((v.full, v.races.map(|(x, m)| (x.id, m))), (None, Some((full.id, Match::Addr))));
    assert!(b.list(T0 + 1)[0].later_owners.is_empty(), "takes nothing in");
    // their own race ban goes first (its message is theirs)
    let (own, _) = b.add(Kind::Races, "Someone", &who(&b, Some(&home), Some("someone"), None), "", Some(T0 + DAY), T0 + 2).unwrap();
    let v = b.by_hello(&Seen { pages: &["someone"], owner: None, addr: Some(&vpn) }, T0 + 3);
    assert_eq!(v.races.map(|(x, m)| (x.id, m)), Some((own.id, Match::Own)));
    // a tool's ban, by its address alone: turned away there
    let tool = b.addr("192.0.2.9");
    let (t, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Tool", &who(&b, Some(&tool), None, None), "", None, T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hello(&b, &["anything"], None, Some(&tool), T0 + 1).map(|x| x.id), Some(t.id));
    assert_eq!(b.covers(&t, &who(&b, Some(&tool), Some("x"), None), T0 + 1), Some(Match::Own));
    let (r, _) = b.add(Kind::Races, "Tool2", &who(&b, Some(&home), None, None), "", None, T0 + 4).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(stranger(&b, &home, T0 + 5), Some((r.id, Match::Own)));
}

// a ban names at most ADDRS_MAX addresses: a player hopping from one VPN server to the next takes nobody else's races
// past those; one whose time is up makes room; a file from before keeps the ones last seen
#[test]
fn a_ban_holds_at_most_three_addresses() {
    let (_d, b) = bans();
    let a = |i: usize| b.addr(&format!("203.0.113.{i}"));
    // made with five (a mark's): the latest three
    let mut k = who(&b, None, Some("p"), None);
    k.addrs = (0..5).map(a).collect();
    let (ban, _) = b.add(Kind::Full, "Hopper", &k, "", None, T0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(ban.addrs.iter().map(|x| x.h.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![a(2), a(3), a(4)]);
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a(1), T0 + 1).is_none());
    // the banned page from another server: not taken in
    assert!(hello(&b, &["p"], None, Some(&a(9)), T0 + 1).is_some(), "still turned away");
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a(9), T0 + 2).is_none());
    // one of the three seen again: a week from then; the others' time up: room for a new one
    assert!(hello(&b, &["p"], None, Some(&a(2)), T0 + 4 * DAY).is_some());
    assert!(hello(&b, &["p"], None, Some(&a(9)), T0 + ADDR_MS).is_some());
    let held: Vec<_> = b.list(T0 + ADDR_MS)[0].addrs.iter().map(|x| x.h.clone()).collect();
    assert_eq!(held, vec![a(2), a(9)]);
    assert!(stranger(&b, &a(9), T0 + ADDR_MS + 1).is_some());
    // a file from before: the three last seen
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let addrs: Vec<String> = (1..=5).map(|i| format!(r#"{{"h":"a{i}","until":{}}}"#, [5, 1, 4, 2, 3][i - 1])).collect();
    let old = format!(r#"{{"next":1,"bans":[{{"id":1,"name":"Old","at":0,"until":null,"pages":["x"],"addrs":[{}]}}]}}"#, addrs.join(","));
    std::fs::write(dir.path().join("bans.json"), old).unwrap();
    let ban = Bans::open(dir.path()).unwrap().list(0)[0].clone();
    assert_eq!(ban.addrs.iter().map(|x| x.h.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec!["a1", "a3", "a5"]);
}
